title: Technical Executive Assistant
description:
**Company Description**
Covalent Projects & Engineering Pvt. Ltd. is a trusted EPC and technology partner focused on ethanol, biofuel, and renewable energy projects. The company specializes in technology sharing and project execution across processes such as fuel ethanol, potable alcohol, hydrolysis, fermentation, distillation, dehydration, evaporation, drying, and ZLD systems. Covalent delivers world-class installations within agreed timeframes while optimizing efficiency and cost-effectiveness. The organization maintains high standards of ethics, professionalism, quality, and long-term commitment to sustainable energy solutions. Team members join a mission-driven environment dedicated to “Manifesting Perpetual Energy.”

**Role Description**

**Technical Understanding & Coordination**

 Develop a working understanding of the company's engineering products,

equipment, systems and project activities.

 Read and understand basic engineering documents such as:

o Technical specifications

o Equipment datasheets

o GA drawings

o P&IDs

o Technical offers

o Quotations

**Client & Vendor Interaction**

 Establish professional rapport with clients and vendors.

 Demonstrate confidence while initiating conversations with new people and

organizations.

 Conduct primary-level discussions with clients/vendors to understand

requirements, opportunities, technical queries and expectations.

 Coordinate collection of information required for Purchase and project

discussions.

 Ensure timely communication and follow-up with external stakeholders.

**Internal Coordination**

 Act as an effective communication link between the Management, external and

internal teams.

 Follow up with respective departments for information, reports, technical inputs

and project updates.

 Prepare meeting minutes, action trackers and follow-up reports.

 Ensure important commitments and deadlines discussed during meeting are

properly tracked.

 Maintain confidentiality of company, client and business information.

**Qualifications**

* Engineering qualification – B.E./B.Tech. preferred.
* 4–5 years of experience in an engineering/EPC/manufacturing/project-oriented organization.
* Good understanding of engineering terminology and ability to read technical documents.
* Excellent spoken and written English.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Confident and comfortable speaking with senior clients, vendors and consultants.
* Ability to connect quickly with new people and adapt to new environments.
* Strong personality with professional etiquette and maturity.
* Ability to initiate conversations.
* Good listening and questioning skills.
* Ability to understand technical requirements even when the discussion is not deeply technical.
* Good presentation and meeting-management skills.
* Strong follow-up and coordination capabilities.
* Proficiency in MS Office, PowerPoint, Excel and professional email communication & updated with use of Social Media platform.
* Willingness to travel for client meetings, exhibitions, seminars and project-related visits.

Desired Personal Attributes

We are looking for someone who is:

Confident | Articulate | Presentable | Technically Curious | Proactive | Adaptable | Well-organized | People-oriented | Good Listener | Strong in Follow-up

title: MA/MI Content Management & System Specialist
description:
At EVERSANA, we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work across the globe. We’re fueled by our vision to create a healthier world. How? Our global team of more than 7,000 employees is committed to creating and delivering next-generation commercialization services to the life sciences industry. We are grounded in our cultural beliefs and serve more than 650 clients ranging from innovative biotech start-ups to established pharmaceutical companies. Our products, services and solutions help bring innovative therapies to market and support the patients who depend on them. Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us!
  
  
Across our growing organization, we embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We look for team members that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but also who care deeply about EVERSANA, our people, clients and most importantly, the patients we serve. We are EVERSANA.
  
  
**Job Description**
**THE POSITION:**
The management of Medical Affairs and Medical Information (MA/MI) content, systems, and data is critical to ensuring medical information resources remain accurate, compliant, accessible, and appropriately governed. Effective execution of these activities requires strong oversight of content classification, user administration, system support, reporting, and document governance processes.
  
  
As part of the MA/MI Operations team, the MA/MI Content Management & System Specialist is responsible for supporting Medical Information systems and content management operations for dedicated clients. The role oversees user management activities, access controls, content classification, metadata governance, system support, reporting, and procedural document management. The specialist works closely with internal stakeholders and support teams to ensure seamless system operations, maintain data quality and consistency, support audits and system releases, and ensure compliance with internal policies, quality standards, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by:
  
  
**User Management Support**

* Coordinate and support user onboarding and offboarding activities within Medical Information (MI) systems.
* Initiate and track training assignment requests for system users.
* Support updates and maintenance of training content.
* Perform user access management activities for MI systems and maintain the user management master file
* Monitor and resolve complaint and incident tickets raised by MI system users.
* Monitor Medical Information support mailboxes and Teams channels, responding to and resolving user requests and issues in a timely manner.
* Update data reports, Power BI dashboards, and maintain SharePoint lists for non-Med Source users
* Provide support to the team responsible for managing the Talent Share tool and associated training and learning activities.
* Liaise with internal support teams for interconnected systems and applications
* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) script development and functionality testing during MI system releases
* Provide support during audits.
* Support the governance, oversight, and management of classification processes for MI enquiries and MI documents.
* Support the oversight, planning, review, approval, and maintenance of procedural documents

**Classification Support**

* Perform metadata classification for Medical Information enquiry cases.
* Perform metadata classification for Medical Information response documents.
* Conduct periodic normalization, harmonization, and maintenance of classifications in alignment with approved lists and established classification standards.

**Medical Affairs and Medical Information Project Management Support**

* Support MA/MI leadership in developing and managing project plans for key initiatives
* Assist in the development and maintenance of project plans and related documentation
* Support the medical content development team in uploading materials into clients’ review and approval platforms, including supporting annotating, anchoring references, etc.
* Demonstrate a commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through continuous development, modeling inclusive behaviors, and proactively managing bias.
* All other duties as assigned.

Consistent with applicable disability, employment, and human rights laws in the jurisdictions in which EVERSANA operates, EVERSANA is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities, unless providing such an accommodation would impose an undue hardship or disproportionate burden on EVERSANA. If reasonable accommodation is needed to perform the essential functions of your position, please contact Human Resources.
  
  
**Expectations Of The Job**

* Travel: In general, this position does not travel.
* Hours: Able to work full-time and be flexible with work scheduling as required by clients and management.
* Metrics: Maintain and contribute toward process improvement which positively impacts metrics associated with activities of the MLR Review process; metrics are subject to change annually or more often as deemed necessary.
* Customer Services: Maintain and improve customer services associated with the activity of the MLR review.
* Time Management: Complete MLR coordination responsibilities in a timely manner.

*The above list reflects the general details necessary to describe the expectations of the position and shall not be construed as the only expectations that may be assigned for the position.*
*An individual in this position must be able to successfully perform the expectations listed above.*
**Minimum Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**
The requirements listed below are representative of the experience, education, knowledge, skill and/or abilities required.
  
  

* Education: Graduates in any Life Sciences / Biomedical field.
* Must demonstrate excellent ability to communicate effectively in English, both orally and in writing.
* Experience and/or Training:

+ A minimum of 2 years of experience in a healthcare agency, pharmaceutical company contact center, or an equivalent environment, with exposure to quality control processes
+ Experience with use of Veeva Vault PromoMats / MedComms / CRM
+ Experience in MLR Coordination
+ Project management
+ Time management
+ Meeting management

* Excellent customer service skills.
* Technology/Equipment: Computer proficiency in Outlook and Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and other Windows applications).

**Qualifications**
**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Education: Graduates/Postgraduates in Pharmacy or Medicine preferred.
* Experience and/or Training

+ Working knowledge of or familiarity with global healthcare compliance statutes and laws.
+ Ability to perform assignments with a high degree of independence requiring extensive experience, skill, and knowledge
+ Excellent computer skills including competency in presentation, word processing and spreadsheet software, utilizing MS Office Suite.
+ Proven ability to manage multiple tasks, set priorities and meet deadlines
+ Ability to manage cross-functional projects
+ Familiar with laws and regulations regarding US drug / device advertising and promotion, including industry best practices

* Knowledge of medical terminology (preferred but not required).
* Must be quality-oriented and demonstrate consistent attention to detail.
* Must have the ability to follow established processes and procedures and the flexibility to adopt new practices and priorities as required.
* Positive Attitude and Energy – Exhibits an upbeat attitude, a genuine interest in others and a sense of humor. Energizes others and heightens morale through her/his attitude.
* Communication Skills – Possesses the ability to develop and articulate ideas and information that generate understanding and create a climate that motivates and encourages others to participate.
* Innovator – Transforms creative ideas into original solutions that positively impact the company’s performance.
* Highly Principled – Proves to be a professional of unquestionable integrity, credibility, and character who demonstrates high moral and ethical behavior.

**Additional Information**
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
  
  
Our team is aware of recent fraudulent job offers in the market, misrepresenting EVERSANA. Recruitment fraud is a sophisticated scam commonly perpetrated through online services using fake websites, unsolicited e-mails, or even text messages claiming to be a legitimate company. Some of these scams request personal information and even payment for training or job application fees. Please know EVERSANA would never require personal information nor payment of any kind during the employment process. We respect the personal rights of all candidates looking to explore careers at EVERSANA.
  
  
From EVERSANA’s inception, Diversity, Equity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds who share a passion for improving the lives of patients and leading innovation within the healthcare industry. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion, and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees’ points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

title: Senior Analyst, VBA Automation (12 months Contract, India Based) : Contract extension possible based on performance
description:
**About Agoda**

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

**\*Contract extension possible based on performance, with additional benefits including a performance bonus and medical insurance\***

**The Opportunity:**

Are you passionate about engineering automation solutions that improve efficiency, accuracy, and control at scale? Do you thrive in a fast-paced, data-driven environment? Agoda’s Finance Operations Excellence is seeking a VBA Automation Specialist to serve as a hands-on technical expert focused on designing, developing, and maintaining automation solutions for finance operations. You will play a key role in building robust tools and workflow automations, modernizing manual processes, and enabling a more scalable and controlled operating model across Finance.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Automation Architecture & Development:**

* Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain automation solutions using Advanced Excel, Macro/VBA, MS Access, SQL, Power Automate, FloQast, and Power Apps.
* Build reliable, scalable, and well-structured solutions with a strong focus on maintainability, performance, control, and user usability.

**Finance Operations Solution Engineering:**

* Partner with Finance operations teams to understand process requirements, identify technical solution options
* Engineer automations for high-volume and control-sensitive workflows across areas such as reconciliations, reporting, validation, close activities, and operational tracking.

**Data Processing & Logic Design:**

* Develop data models, query logic, input/output structures, and exception-handling routines using Excel, Access, and SQL.
* Optimize existing tools by improving logic design, reducing processing time, strengthening validation layers, and enhancing auditability.

**Workflow Automation & Systems Enablement:**

* Build and enhance workflow-based solutions using Power Automate, FloQast, and Power Apps to reduce manual handoffs, improve process standardization,
* Support stronger controls and transparency across finance operations.

**Technical Documentation & Change Control:**

Create and maintain high-quality technical documentation including solution design notes, process logic, code commenting, SOPs, testing evidence, version histories, and user guidance to ensure sustainable ownership and supportability.

**Issue Resolution & Continuous Improvement:**

* Troubleshoot defects, resolve production issues, support enhancement requests
* Proactively identify opportunities to refactor or upgrade existing automations.
* Contribute to improving development standards, documentation quality, and reusability of automation components.

**What You’ll Need to Succeed:**

**Technical & Functional Skills**

* Advanced proficiency in Excel, including complex formulas, structured models, large-volume data handling, and spreadsheet-based solution design.
* Strong hands-on expertise in Macro/VBA automation coding, including development of modular, maintainable, and well-documented solutions.
* Strong experience with MS Access and SQL for data storage, query development, data transformation, and reporting support.
* Hands-on experience in workflow automation tools such as Power Automate, FloQast, and Power Apps.
* Strong technical ability to convert business requirements into structured, reliable, and supportable automation solutions.
* Good understanding of process controls, exception handling, validation design, and documentation practices in an operations environment.
* Experience developing automation solutions in Finance operations environments is preferred.
* Python-based automation, Tableau/Power BI, and ERP scripting experience are not a must but good to have.

**Behavioral Attributes**

* Strong structured problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose issues logically and design practical technical solutions.
* Well organized with strong attention to detail, especially in code structure, testing, versioning, and documentation.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to work directly with Finance operations end-users to gather requirements, explain solutions, and support adoption.
* Strong documentation discipline and a high standard for supportability, clarity, and technical quality.
* Self-starter with a hands-on engineering mindset and the ability to independently manage technical deliverables in a fast-paced environment.
* Adaptable, dependable, and comfortable balancing delivery speed with control and quality.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in a technical field such as Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related discipline.
* 5+ years of relevant experience in automation development
  **is required (VBA and Power Automate are required), Good to have (SQL,Tableau, Power BI )**
* Experience in developing automations for Finance operations is preferred.
* Experience in a tech or e-commerce environment is an advantage.
* Professional certifications or training in automation, analytics, systems development, or process improvement are a plus.

title: Engineer - Reliability
description:
**What You’ll Do**
**Eaton announced, on January 26, 2026, the intent to separate its Mobility Group (including both the Vehicle and eMobility segments) into an independent, publicly traded company. We expect to complete the separation by the end of the first quarter of 2027. As a standalone company, the Mobility business will be more focused and agile, creating exciting opportunities for employees to grow, innovate, and help shape the future of mobility. The separation reflects strong confidence in the Mobility team and positions the new company as an employer of choice in the automotive and commercial vehicle industry.**
The compensation and benefits that will initially be offered for this position are based on Eaton's plans, programs and practices. If you are offered and accept this position and are actively employed by the Mobility Group when the spinoff closes, the new company will provide further details to employees concerning compensation and benefits at that time.
  
  
**Responsibility**

* Create and/or revise DFR deliverables such as Reliability goal setting, Reliability Predictions, Failure Mode Effects Analysis (FMEA), Accelerated Life Test , Reliability Demonstration Test (RDT), Reliability Growth analysis ,FRACAS for NPIs, VAVE projects and/or existing product improvements.
* Work with cross functional team as well as global reliability engineering team for designing in reliability on NPI programs and/or existing product improvements,VAVE projects & responsible for identifying, managing and mitigating reliability risks under supervision of senior.
* Planning project milestones, executing milestones, conducting deliverables reviews, communication with stakeholder and on-job development through technical mentoring.
* Along with warranty monitoring, forecasting, reporting; develop actuarial models library for eMobility components

**Qualifications**
Education level required : Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering. Preferred: Master’s Degree in Reliability Engineering.
  
  
Experience : 0-1 Years
  
  
**Technical Knowledge**

* Skilled in the areas of reliability statistics, FMEA, FTA,8D,FRACAS, life modelling & analyzing field/warranty data into relevant life and failure rate information.
* Experience with any industry proven reliability analysis suite of tools like Minitab, Reliasoft preferred.
* Desired: Work experience in the Eletrical/Electronics systems preferably Power electronics(Inverter/Converters), Power systems, battery, inverters, protection circuits etc.

**Job Description**
Position Purpose/Objective (in broad terms describe what the job does and the expected end results)
  
  
Global IT is on a strategic journey to modernize Microsoft 365 collaboration capabilities, delivering secure, scalable and user-friendly SharePoint Online services across all global sites.
  
  
The Technical Consultant – SharePoint Online sits within the IT – Core Business Solutions team and serves as the primary technical authority for SharePoint Online, modern SharePoint architecture and the SharePoint Framework (SPFx). This role is responsible for designing, developing, migrating and optimizing SharePoint Online solutions, including the modernization and migration of classic SharePoint sites to the SharePoint Online modern experience.
  
  
Reporting to the ITDP/Solution Architect, this role combines deep Microsoft 365 engineering expertise with automation and integration skills across Power Automate, PowerShell and Azure cloud services. The consultant leads technical delivery, guides best-practice adoption, supports governance and compliance, and ensures the platform remains secure, maintainable and future-ready in alignment with digital transformation roadmap.
  
  
MAJOR ACCOUNTABILITIES (list KEY activities, expected results and the ways results are measured)
  
  

* Take ownership of the functional and technical solutions in the designated Microsoft 365 / SharePoint domain.
* Review and manage changes and daily operations delivered by external partners, ensuring quality, maintainability and adherence to standards.
* Translate business requirements into clear SharePoint Online functional and technical designs, including information architecture, security model, automation and integration patterns.

Technical Ownership & Governance
  
  

* Act as the primary technical SME for SharePoint Online, modern sites, communication sites, team sites, hub sites, lists, libraries, content types and metadata models.
* Define and maintain SharePoint Online governance covering site lifecycle, ownership, permissions, external sharing, naming standards, information protection, retention and operational support handover.
* Establish best-practice design principles for SharePoint Online solutions, covering usability, accessibility, searchability, performance, security, maintainability and supportability.
* Provide technical guidance to business stakeholders, IT Business Partners, Solution Architects, AMS teams and external delivery partners.

Design, Build, Migration & Automation
  
  

* Design, develop and support modern SharePoint Framework (SPFx) solutions using the latest supported SPFx patterns, including web parts, extensions and reusable components aligned to development standards.
* Lead the migration and modernization of classic SharePoint sites to SharePoint Online, including assessment, remediation, migration planning, modern site design, validation and post-migration stabilization.
* Develop and maintain Power Automate cloud flows for approvals, notifications, document lifecycle automation and business process orchestration, replacing legacy workflows where applicable.
* Use PowerShell and PnP PowerShell for SharePoint Online administration, provisioning, permissions reporting, bulk updates, migration support and operational automation.
* Design and implement integrations with Microsoft platform services including Azure cloud services, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Graph, Teams and other enterprise applications where required.
* Define reusable templates, provisioning patterns, runbooks and technical standards for secure and scalable SharePoint Online delivery.
* Participate in solution reviews, change reviews, testing, deployment and hypercare for SharePoint Online enhancements and migration releases.
* Respond to security, compliance and audit observations by remediating configuration gaps and providing evidence for implemented controls.

Delivery & Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Engage with business stakeholders to refine requirements and convert them into practical Microsoft 365 / SharePoint Online solutions.
* Coordinate with AMS vendors and third-party partners to ensure operational continuity, release coordination, incident/problem resolution and knowledge transfer.
* Support escalations and complex issue resolution related to SharePoint Online, Power Automate, PowerShell automation, Azure integrations and migration defects.

Team & Capability
  
  

* Ensure proper documentation, configuration records, solution design documents and runbooks are maintained for the SharePoint Online platform.
* Promote best practices, knowledge sharing, reuse of standard components and continuous improvement across Microsoft 365 collaboration services.

We value diversity as a cornerstone of our success. We are committed to nurturing and empowering every individual to reach their full potential.

title: Engineer II Electrical & Electronics Engineering X
description:
**Job Description**
**Job Description for Sr. Engineer – Product (VAVE & Sustaining)**
**Job Description**
Lead and coordinate with design, production, procurement, and product testing teams to validate cost-optimized solutions for existing and new products under VAVE (Value Analysis and Value Engineering) initiatives. The primary responsibility is to ensure reliability, functional integrity, and certification compliance after implementing VAVE changes. This role requires validating design and component modifications through structured testing, automation programs, and compliance assessments. The candidate must ensure that all VAVE changes maintain product performance, safety, and quality standards without compromising customer requirements. Being part of a Global Engineering Function, the role demands strict adherence to defined processes and communication protocols.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Perform testing and validation of VAVE-related design and component changes in power supply products, modules, and systems.
* Conduct hardware and software testing (black box/white box) for communication power products to ensure compliance post-cost optimization.
* Develop and maintain automated test programs for validating VAVE modifications efficiently.
* Formulate test plans, stress conditions, and procedures for evaluating new components or design changes introduced through VAVE.
* Collaborate with design, procurement, reliability, and compliance teams to verify cost-optimized solutions without affecting performance.
* Ensure all VAVE changes comply with UL, CE, and other international safety and certification standards.
* Prepare detailed test reports, risk analysis, and recommendations for each VAVE implementation.
* Participate in root cause analysis for failures during VAVE validation and provide corrective action inputs.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance cost competitiveness while maintaining high reliability and safety standards.

**Job Specifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Power Electronics / Electrical Engineering or equivalent.
* Experience: 5 to 6 years of experience in power electronics product/module testing (AC/DC chargers, DC/DC converters, UPS preferred).
* Hands-on experience in automation testing tools and programming for test systems.
* Strong understanding of analog and digital circuits, power conversion principles, and common topologies.
* Knowledge of safety certification processes (UL, CE) preferred.
* Familiarity with VAVE methodology, cost optimization principles, and supplier component qualification.
* Proactive, analytical, and result-oriented, with the ability to think critically and solve problems independently.
* Excellent time management skills with the ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills (written and verbal in English).

**Key Skills**

* VAVE (Value Analysis & Value Engineering) implementation and testing
* Power electronics testing (AC/DC rectifier, DC/DC converters, UPS)
* Automation testing and scripting
* Analog & digital electronics troubleshooting
* Compliance & certification validation (UL, CE)
* Test plan creation and execution
* Cost optimization validation techniques
* Strong problem-solving and root cause analysis
* Hands-on test and measurement capability (oscilloscopes, power analyzers, etc.)

**About Us**
**The successful candidate will embrace Vertiv’s Core Principles & Behaviors to help execute our Strategic Priorities.**
**OUR CORE PRINCIPLES:**
Safety. Integrity. Respect. Teamwork. Inclusion.
  
  
**OUR STRATEGIC PRIORITIES**

* High-Performance Culture
* Customer Focus
* Operational Excellence
* Innovation
* Financial Strength

**VERTIV BEHAVIORS**

* Own it
* Act with urgency
* Foster a customer-first mindset
* Think big and execute
* Lead by example
* Drive continuous improvement
* Learn and seek out development
* Promote transparent & open communication

**About Vertiv**
Vertiv (NYSE: VRT) brings together hardware, software, analytics and ongoing services to enable its customers’ vital applications to run continuously, perform optimally and grow with their business needs. Vertiv solves the most important challenges facing today’s data centers, communication networks, and commercial and industrial facilities with a portfolio of power, cooling and IT infrastructure solutions and services that extend from the cloud to the edge of the network. Headquartered in Westerville, Ohio, USA, Vertiv employs around 34,000 people and does business in more than 130 countries. Visit Vertiv.com to learn more.

description:
The Quality Assurance Ops Support Analyst 1 is an entry-level position responsible for supporting quality assurance and operational control activities within Core Operations. The role includes conducting quality reviews, monitoring adherence to established processes and regulatory requirements, maintaining documentation, identifying process gaps, and supporting continuous improvement initiatives in coordination with Operations, Compliance, and Business teams. Additionally, the Quality Assurance Analyst serves as a liaison between operations staff, relationship managers, project managers, custodians, and clients. The overall objective of this role is to ensure high-quality service delivery, operational excellence, and compliance with Citi policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Perform quality assurance reviews and business analysis of current and future state Client Reports and Advices (client communication letters, notices, and confirms).
* Review operational processes and transactions to ensure compliance with established procedures, regulatory requirements, and quality standards.
* Identify defects, process gaps, control weaknesses, and improvement opportunities through quality monitoring activities.
* Conduct root cause analysis and recommend corrective and preventive actions to improve quality, accuracy, and operational efficiency.
* Provide regular status updates for all project participants and create presentations for management and steering committee updates.
* Work with various Legal, Compliance, Operations, and Business teams to obtain sign-off on all regulatory business requirements.
* Serve as a primary liaison between key business stakeholders and technology teams, including recommending business priorities by advising stakeholders on options, risks, costs, prioritizations, and delivery timelines.
* Recommend business priorities by advising stakeholders on options, risks, costs, prioritizations, and delivery timelines.
* Create and facilitate training sessions, webcast demos, quality refreshers, and write User Acceptance Test (UAT) scripts and business scenarios against specified requirements.
* Create, manage, and maintain project plans and act as the project coordinator for all follow-ups across various departments.
* Work on multiple projects in parallel focusing on continued delivery of regulatory client deliverables, such as legal statements, performance reporting, advices, letters, and notices.
* Prepare quality reports, scorecards, management information reports, and trend analysis to support operational decision-making.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing customer experience, operational effectiveness, and quality performance.

title: Customer Engineering Product Specialist
description:
**Job Summary**
This dual customer/product focused position serves as the senior technical liaison between OEMs, Customers, sales and represents our customers during new product development programs. Applying Cummins’ products to customer vehicles requires the development of technical specifications, implementing new design configurations, and delivering high performance, low-cost equipment and system solutions integrated with customers’ products in a variety of applications. Integrating high quality and optimized customer solutions requires the interaction with sales and marketing teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Application Engineering in alternator. Obtains input and negotiates with Subject Matter Experts and Value Package Introduction (VPI) Teams and delivers product data and installation requirements to Application Engineers and OEMs Makes decisions in the areas of product selection, design, and integration that impact OEM machine performance, optimization and quality Applies and improves processes such as Installation Quality Assurance, OEM integration and product selection and tools such as Advisor, Cummins OnLine Specifications (COLS) and Global Customer Engineering (GCE) required to support the processes and enable high quality decision making. Develops strong working relationships with customer technical counterparts to serve as their primary liaison to deliver specialized product technical information, manage product specifications, communicate product change information, conduct complex installation issue resolutions and facilitate customer requests Applies technical expertise in the areas of product, application and market knowledge to support OEM product selection and equipment design Leads the translation of customer needs and "voice of the customer" into functional product requirements to provide input on program-related decisions Serves as customer/market advocate inside Cummins during participation in new product development programs, design reviews and product change request processes Ensures products are applied and installed correctly to meet customer system requirements and environments Assures installation quality by validating prototype machine performance and ensuring installations meet Cummins requirements Utilizes Analysis Led Design (ALD) and Six Sigma tools to optimize product and system performance Proposes innovative customer-focused initiatives and projects Assists with the transfer of knowledge through coaching and mentoring less experienced engineers Provides independent leadership of smaller business impact projects or ownership of complex components, products, systems or services with greater elements of ambiguity over the senior or lead engineer level and with full accountability to the project team. Delivers independent execution of established and emerging work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge. Leads the development and improvement of work processes and systems across a functional discipline area within a business unit site. Coordinates and directs work amongst technicians and temporary student employees, assists in the transfer of knowledge to lesser experienced engineers through either indirect (scope of influence) or direct management of a small, local group of engineers. Provides support and guidance to influence technical direction within a project team and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role. Operates as a recognized specialist in a discipline or product area within the immediate team.
  
  
**Competencies**
Machine Integration and Optimization - Combines various parts or sub-systems into a whole to achieve the output most desired by the customer; applies Cummins' installation requirements using our standard tools, processes and identified best practices to ensure optimization of performance, reliability, cost and quality; analyzes technical issues using proven problem-solving and troubleshooting techniques for rapid resolution.
  
  
Product Application Support - Ensures new product information is available by developing and managing accurate and complete technical content in a timely manner to support our customers and the business; provides new options through management of technical systems to support sales to all of our markets; defines installation requirements and develops innovative tools with in-depth, cross-system knowledge and industry experience for successful design and integration.
  
  
Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis - Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub-system and/or component level requirements.
  
  
Product Installation Quality - Identifies and applies ways to improve machine integration to minimize rework and deliver the best product; applies standard Cummins processes based on the experience and knowledge of product installation experts; ensures that products are installed correctly and meet requirements through an installation review process.
  
  
Product Problem Solving - Solves product problems using a process that protects the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; and identifies the systemic root causes and recommended actions to prevent problem reoccurrence.
  
  
Product Selection - Guides customers to the best product offerings for their markets and applications; offers best-fit solutions to customers by optimizing product specifications to make Cummins' offerings easy to install into new applications; represents features and benefits of products in terms that customers understand; ensures Cummins' products aren't misapplied through using Cummins' technical information systems, local and application requirements.
  
  
Technical Customer Management - Represents Cummins to our customers by being the interface for all technical aspects; provides engineering data, documentation and training to customers to support the design and integration of equipment; ensures that the customer's business is not interrupted by managing Cummins' product changes through the use of our change processes and regular communications with Product Development and the customer.
  
  
Builds networks - Effectively building formal and informal relationship networks inside and outside the organization.
  
  
Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
  
  
Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.
  
  
Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.
  
  
Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
  
  
Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
  
  
Resourcefulness - Securing and deploying resources effectively and efficiently.
  
  
Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
  
  
**Education, Licenses, Certifications**
College, university, or equivalent Bachelor's degree in Engineering or appropriate STEM field is required.
  
  
Post-graduate (Master's) degree relevant to this discipline area may be required for select roles.
  
  
This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.
  
  
**Experience**
Prior Senior or Lead Engineer equivalent work experience in a relevant discipline area is required with a demonstrated track record of technical problem solving and quality decision making. Knowledge of MS Office tools is preferred
  
  
**The Candidate Should Have**

* A degree in Electrical or Electrical & Electronics Engineering.
* Relevant experience with generators, alternators, gensets, electrical machines, or power-generation systems.
* Hands-on experience in application, product, systems, Tech centre, or customer engineering.
* Experience responding to customer technical enquiries and recommending engineering solutions.
* Experience coordinating product-integration activities with cross-functional teams.
* Strong knowledge of electrical-machine performance and applicable engineering standards like IEC/IS/NEMA/CSA etc.
* Ability to independently manage Application Engineering responsibilities.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

description:

We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We look for team members that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but also who care deeply about EVERSANA, our people, clients and most importantly, the patients we serve. We are EVERSANA.
  
  
**Job Description**
**THE POSITION**
**:**
**Technical Consultant**
plays a crucial role in pharmacovigilance, particularly in the context of the Argus Safety System. The responsibilities of an Argus administrator, as outlined, involve various aspects of configuration, data management, automation, and collaboration with case processing teams.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by:
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Configure, maintain, and optimize Oracle Argus Safety to support pharmacovigilance operations and regulatory reporting requirements.
* Analyze business requirements and implement Argus configurations aligned with regulatory standards and industry best practices.
* Design, develop, and enhance Argus workflows, business rules, and automation solutions to improve operational efficiency.
* Participate in end-to-end pharmacovigilance data migration projects, including data assessment, profiling, mapping, transformation, validation, and reconciliation activities.
* Collaborate with business, safety, and technical teams to define migration requirements and source-to-target mapping specifications.
* Perform data extraction, transformation, validation, and reconciliation activities to ensure accurate and compliant migration of safety data into Argus Safety.
* Develop and execute SQL queries for data analysis, reporting, migration validation, and issue investigation.
* Identify and resolve application, configuration, integration, and data-related issues within the Argus Safety environment.
* Support system integrations between Argus Safety and external applications using web services and related technologies.
* Develop, customize, and maintain reports and dashboards using Oracle BI Publisher (BIP) to support operational and regulatory reporting needs.
* Participate in testing activities, including system integration testing (SIT), user acceptance testing (UAT), and migration validation testing.
* Ensure system configurations, migrated data, and business processes comply with global pharmacovigilance regulations, including FDA, EMA, and other applicable requirements.
* Support validation documentation and compliance activities for audits, inspections, system upgrades, and regulatory reviews.
* Collaborate with Oracle Support and internal stakeholders for incident management, patch deployments, and system enhancements.
* Provide end-user support, training, and documentation to promote effective system utilization and knowledge sharing.
* Monitor regulatory updates, Argus product enhancements, and industry trends to recommend continuous process and system improvements.
* Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

*Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.*
**Qualifications**
The requirements listed below are representative of the experience, education, knowledge, skill and/or abilities required.
  
  

* Participate in end-to-end pharmacovigilance data migration projects, including data assessment, profiling, mapping, transformation, validation, and reconciliation activities.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, Pharmacovigilance, Regulatory Affairs, and IT teams to gather migration and reporting requirements.
* Develop and maintain source-to-target mapping documents, data migration specifications, and reconciliation reports.
* Execute data extraction, transformation, cleansing, and validation activities to ensure data quality and integrity throughout the migration lifecycle.
* Perform SQL-based data analysis, data validation, reconciliation, and issue investigation to support migration and reporting activities.
* Identify, analyze, and resolve data discrepancies, mapping issues, and migration defects.
* Support migration testing activities, including System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and post-migration validation.
* Conduct data reconciliation between source and target systems to ensure completeness, accuracy, and compliance of migrated data.
* Design, develop, customize, and maintain Oracle BI Publisher (BIP) reports, line listings, and regulatory outputs based on business requirements.
* Create and optimize complex data models, templates, and report layouts within Oracle BI Publisher.
* Support generation and validation of operational, regulatory, and management reports using BIP and database queries.
* Develop and optimize SQL queries, stored procedures, and scripts to support reporting, migration, and data analysis requirements.
* Collaborate with technical teams to support integrations, data interfaces, and reporting solutions across pharmacovigilance systems.
* Participate in system upgrades, enhancements, and migration projects, ensuring reporting and data validation requirements are met.
* Prepare and maintain migration documentation, validation evidence, test scripts, SOPs, and technical specifications.
* Ensure migrated data and reporting processes comply with pharmacovigilance regulations and organizational data governance standards.
* Provide end-user support and training related to migration deliverables, reporting solutions, and BI Publisher reports.
* Monitor reporting performance and recommend process improvements to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and compliance.
* Stay current with Oracle BI Publisher enhancements, data migration best practices, and emerging pharmacovigilance technologies.
* PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:
* Bachelor’s degree/Masters Degree in IT Stream
* 3+ years of relevant experience in drug safety IT Systems

**Additional Information**
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
  
  
Our team is aware of recent fraudulent job offers in the market, misrepresenting EVERSANA. Recruitment fraud is a sophisticated scam commonly perpetrated through online services using fake websites, unsolicited e-mails, or even text messages claiming to be a legitimate company. Some of these scams request personal information and even payment for training or job application fees. Please know EVERSANA would never require personal information nor payment of any kind during the employment process. We respect the personal rights of all candidates looking to explore careers at EVERSANA.
  
  
From EVERSANA’s inception, Diversity, Equity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds who share a passion for improving the lives of patients and leading innovation within the healthcare industry. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion, and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees’ points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

title: Configuration Manager (TT610ST RM 4532)
description:
**Position: Configuration Manager (TT610ST RM 4532)**
**Role Purpose**
Own software configuration management for automotive programs, ensuring controlled ALM workflows, versioning, baselines, releases, traceability, and ASPICE-aligned configuration evidence
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and maintain the software configuration management plan, branching strategy, naming conventions, access controls, and release workflow.
* Administer and coordinate the ALM toolchain across requirements, change management, source control, build, artifact storage, and release records.
* Manage version identification, configuration items, baselines, tags, branches, release packages, and delivery content.
* Ensure controlled change requests, impact assessment records, approvals, status accounting, and audit trails.
* Coordinate baseline creation and acceptance across requirements, architecture, source code, configuration, test assets, tools, and release documentation.
* Perform configuration audits and support ASPICE assessments with objective evidence and traceability.
* Monitor configuration integrity, deviations, unauthorized changes, and baseline consistency across teams.
* Publish release notes, configuration status reports, known issues, and reproducibility information.

**Required Experience And Competencies**

* Strong experience with ALM toolchains and software configuration management in embedded or automotive programs.
* Hands-on knowledge of Git or equivalent version-control systems, branching, merging, tagging, and release baselines.
* Experience with change management, build and release coordination, artifact repositories, and configuration audits.
* Good understanding of ASPICE configuration management and change request management expectations.
* Ability to define practical governance, automate status collection, and maintain reliable audit evidence.
* Strong coordination and communication across engineering, quality, project, and customer-facing teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins and enterprise ALM platforms such as IBM RTC, Codebeamer, Polarion, or equivalent.
* Familiarity with software bill of materials, open-source compliance, or release compliance checks.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a related discipline. Equivalent relevant industry experience may also be considered

**Expected Leadership Behaviors**

* Own technical and delivery outcomes with clear risk communication and timely escalation.
* Promote reuse, documentation quality, disciplined reviews, and cross-team collaboration.
* Coach team members and support fact-based decisions using requirements, architecture, logs, metrics, and validation evidence.

title: Controls Engineer
description: Position Summary JOB DESCRIPTION The IBMS System Architecture Expert – Design & Estimation incumbent serves as the primary technical authority for IBMS scope definition, system architecture design, cost estimation, and technical proposal development across mission-critical data centre bids. The role demands deep expertise in Integrated Building Management Systems (IBMS), a thorough understanding of BMS/DDC/PLC controller ecosystems, and the ability to translate complex client requirements into compelling, commercially sound technical proposals. Working at the intersection of Engineering, Sales, and Solution Architecture, the IBMS System Architecture Expert drives technical credibility during the bid cycle — from RFP/RFQ receipt through final bid submission and post-bid technical clarification. B. Bill of Quantities, Cost Estimation & Proposal Development C. Technical Proposals & Bid Documentation D. Client Engagement & Presales Support E. Internal Collaboration & Presales Standards 3. AUTHORITIES KEY RESPONSIBILITIES System Architecture & Scope Definition Develop full IBMS system architecture proposals for mission-critical data center projects during the bid phase, encompassing BMS, FACP, VESDA, Water Leak Detection (WLD), Access Control, CCTV, Rodent Control, and power/environment monitoring subsystems. Define BMS controller platform, network topology, and integration architecture — specifying primary, field-level devices, gateways, and communication protocols (BACnet/IP, Modbus, SNMP, OPC-UA). Prepare detailed I/O point schedules, controller loading calculations, and scan-time calculations for DDC/PLC systems during the estimation phase. Design IBMS network architecture including data network topology, switch selection criteria, BACnet/IP architecture, and integration requirements for third-party systems (DCIM, EPMS, SCADA/HMI). Evaluate and recommend open protocol versus proprietary integration strategies, identifying technical risks and mitigations for the proposed architecture. Define subsystem integration requirements, API/protocol mapping, and IBMS-to-DCIM interoperability architecture for high-density and AI data center environments. Develop control philosophy summaries and sequences of operation (SOO) drafts to support technical sections of bids, clarifying system-level control strategies without committing to detailed execution design. Prepare comprehensive Bill of Quantities (BOQ) for IBMS scope across critical and non-critical data center projects, covering all hardware, software, licensing, integration, engineering, and commissioning cost elements. Develop itemized cost estimation sheets with material, labor, third-party integration, software licensing, and contingency allowances, using established Vertiv rate cards and vendor quotations. Produce Basis of Estimate (BOE) documents clearly defining scope boundaries, assumptions, exclusions, and unit-cost rationale for each IBMS bid. Benchmark IBMS costs against historical project data, vendor list prices, and market intelligence to ensure commercial competitiveness without compromising technical quality. Identify and quantify scope risks in estimates, recommending provisional sums and risk allowances where appropriate. Prepare and maintain IBMS-specific pricing matrices and parametric estimation models to accelerate turnaround for repeat bid types (colocation, hyperscale, enterprise DC). Contribute to internal bid review and approval processes — presenting cost models, assumptions, and risks to senior management and business development leads. Lead preparation of technical proposal sections for IBMS scope in RFP/RFQ responses, including executive summaries, technical narratives, compliance matrices, and scope clarification letters. Develop technical write-ups describing the proposed IBMS architecture, system capabilities, integration approach, and value differentiators — tailored to client technical and commercial requirements. Prepare compliance matrices mapping client specifications and standards requirements (IEC 61850, ASHRAE, TIA-942, NFPA 72, EN 54, IS 3043, NBC 2016) against the proposed solution. Produce scope-of-work documents and exclusion lists that define clear contractual boundaries for the IBMS scope within the overall project. Develop technical clarification logs and pre-bid query registers, managing responses with accuracy and commercial awareness. Prepare value engineering proposals and alternative technical solutions where client requirements offer scope for cost optimization without reducing functional integrity. Ensure all bid documents are produced in accordance with Vertiv brand and documentation standards, with consistent formatting and professional presentation. Act as the primary technical point of contact for IBMS scope during client pre-bid meetings, site surveys, and technical clarification discussions. Conduct technical feasibility assessments for proposed IBMS architectures, advising clients and the sales team on achievable scope, realistic timelines, and technical risks. Prepare and deliver technical presentations, solution overviews, and IBMS architecture demonstrations to client technical teams and procurement stakeholders. Participate in pre-bid site walks, capturing existing infrastructure constraints, network connectivity requirements, and integration opportunities. Support post-submission technical discussions, clarifications, and negotiation of technical scope with clients and consultants. Build and maintain trusted technical relationships with key clients, consultants, and specifiers in the data center and critical infrastructure markets. Provide technical input to sales team's go/no-go assessments, identifying bid qualification criteria and scope risks early in the sales cycle. Collaborate with Sales, Solution Architecture, Project Management, and Commercial teams throughout the bid lifecycle, ensuring aligned scope, schedule, and cost assumptions. Maintain and continuously improve IBMS presales estimation templates, BOQ master libraries, and technical proposal boilerplate in line with evolving product platforms and market requirements. Conduct lessons-learned analysis on won and lost bids to refine estimation accuracy, technical positioning, and proposal quality. Support peer review and quality assurance of IBMS proposals prepared by other team members, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and compliance with Vertiv standards. Provide technical mentoring and knowledge transfer to junior presales engineers and sales staff on IBMS architecture concepts and estimation methodology. Interface with the Vertiv product management and engineering teams to stay current on controller platforms, new product introductions, and integration capabilities relevant to presales. The IBMS System Architecture Expert – Presales & Estimation holds the following delegated authorities within the presales and estimation function: Approve IBMS BOQ, cost estimates, and technical proposals prior to submission to the commercial review board, within authorized value limits. Define and confirm IBMS technical scope inclusions and exclusions in bid submissions without requiring individual engineering sign-off for standard scope items. Recommend go/no-go decisions on IBMS scope elements and flag technical red-flags to the Bid Manager or Lead Controls Engineer. Engage directly with clients, consultants, and specialist vendors during the bid phase for technical clarifications, pre-bid meetings, and scope discussions. Request vendor quotations for specialist IBMS equipment, software, and integration services to support estimation. Propose value engineering changes and alternative technical solutions during bid development, subject to review by the Lead Controls Engineer. Reject internally submitted estimation data or technical content that does not meet Vertiv quality standards or accuracy thresholds. 4. QUALIFICATIONS 4.1 Education Dip OR bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Electronics & Communication, Instrumentation, Automation & Control, or a closely related technical discipline. Additional certifications in BMS/IBMS platforms are strongly preferred: Distech Controls, Niagara Framework / Tridium JACE, Honeywell, or Schneider Electric EcoStruxure. Training or certification in estimation methodology, technical proposal writing, or pre-sales engineering is a positive differentiator. Project management training (PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent) is advantageous for managing complex bid timelines and multi-stakeholder reviews. 4.2 Experience 5–7 years of progressive experience in IBMS/BMS controls engineering, with a minimum of 4 years in a presales, estimation, or solution architecture capacity. Demonstrated track record of preparing IBMS BOQs, cost estimates, and technical proposals for mission-critical data center projects. Hands-on experience with BMS controller platforms — DDC/PLC platforms. Proven experience defining IBMS network architectures and communication integration strategies (BACnet/IP, Modbus TCP, SNMP, OPC-UA, REST API). Experience engaging with clients, consultants, and specifiers in a presales or solution-advisory capacity for critical infrastructure projects. Familiarity with data center standards and design criteria: ASHRAE, TIA-942, IEC 61850, EN 54, NFPA 72, IS 3043, NBC 2016. Exposure to high-density cooling architectures (DLC, liquid cooling, CDUs) and AI data center workloads is highly advantageous. 4.3 Technical Skills MatrixSkill Area Proficiency RequiredIBMS Subsystems Deep understanding of BMS, FACP, VESDA, WLD, Rodent Control, CCTV, Access Control, MDBs, and EPMS in critical data center facilities.Controller Platforms Proficiency in controller loading calculations, I/O mapping, and scan-time calculations for DDC/PLC systems.BOQ & Cost Estimation Ability to prepare detailed, accurate IBMS BOQs and cost estimation sheets including hardware, software, licensing, integration, and engineering effort.Network & Integration Architecture Proficiency in IBMS network topology design, protocol selection (BACnet/IP, Modbus, SNMP, OPC-UA), switch sizing, and third-party integration mapping (DCIM, SCADA, EPMS).Technical Proposal Writing Ability to produce clear, structured technical narratives, compliance matrices, scope-of-work documents, and value engineering proposals for complex bids.Standards & Codes Working knowledge of IEC 61850, EN 54, NFPA 72, ASHRAE, TIA-942, BS EN 62305, IS 3043, NBC 2016, and Vertiv internal standards (G-FI-PL-006).Thermal Management Knowledge of data center thermal management: CRAH/CRAC, chilled water plant, CDU/liquid cooling (DLC), and environmental monitoring in high-density environments.Software Tools MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, Visio, Project), AutoCAD, estimation/CPQ tools, and documentation management platforms.SCADA / HMI / DCIM Familiarity with SCADA/HMI platforms for IBMS visualization, alarm management, and DCIM integration for data center monitoring.4.4 Soft Skills & Competencies Excellent written and verbal communication in English; ability to present complex IBMS architecture concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Commercial acumen: ability to balance technical quality with cost competitiveness and understand bid strategy and margin implications. Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills; able to decompose complex client requirements into definable, priceable scope elements. High attention to detail with the ability to maintain accuracy across large, multi-subsystem BOQs and complex technical proposals. Ability to manage multiple concurrent bids under time pressure without compromising quality or accuracy. Collaborative team player with the confidence to challenge technical and commercial assumptions respectfully and constructively. Self-motivated with a quality-first mindset; proactive in identifying risks and gaps during the bid cycle. 5. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Experience working with the Vertiv InfraSol platform or similar critical infrastructure integrated solutions in a presales or solution architecture capacity. Familiarity with AI data center workloads — high-density liquid cooling (DLC/immersion), power distribution architecture, and intelligent environmental monitoring. PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management certification, demonstrating structured approach to managing bid timelines and multi-stakeholder reviews. Knowledge of ISA/IEC instrumentation standards and engineering flowchart conventions for controls systems architecture. Experience preparing parametric estimation models and CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) frameworks for repeatable IBMS bid packages. Demonstrated experience with multi-hyperscale or multi-colocation client environments — understanding of client template specifications and standard scope requirements. Familiarity with sustainability-driven IBMS features: energy monitoring, power analytics, PUE optimization, and ESG reporting integration for data centers. 6. PHYSICAL & ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS Primarily office-based role with occasional site visits required for pre-bid surveys, client technical meetings, and solution demonstration events. Comfortable working in active data center environments during pre-bid site surveys: raised floors, live electrical equipment, and operational cooling infrastructure. Ability to work extended hours during peak bid periods, proposal submission deadlines, and multi-bid parallel cycles. Travel required: approximately 10–25% of working time, primarily domestic within India, with occasional international travel for major client engagements or vendor partner events.

description:

The role involves maintenance engineering, system analysis, bid preparation, lifecycle support, cost estimation, documentation, and coordination with cross-functional teams to deliver competitive and compliant Telecom service solutions.
  
  
The engineer will contribute to preventive, corrective, and condition-based maintenance strategies while ensuring adherence to customer requirements, railway standards, safety regulations, and company processes.
  
  
**You’ll make a difference by**

* Conduct technical discussions with all stakeholders.
* Act as a problem solver while ensuring compliance with applicable railway standards and project requirements.
* Act as Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for Telecom service system engineering, ensuring clear communication and alignment with stakeholders.

* Analyze customer requirements, technical specifications, and tender documents.

* Estimate service workload, spare parts requirements, tools, and asset lifecycle costs.
* Support cost calculations, risk assessments, and bid reviews.
* Coordinate with engineering, procurement, finance, operations, and commercial teams during bid preparation.
* Support technical clarifications and customer queries during tender phases.

* Support execution of Telecom service and maintenance projects.

* Prepare maintenance documentation, procedures, and work instructions.
* Monitor project deliverables, milestones, and technical compliance.
* Support system modifications, upgrades, migrations, and obsolescence management activities.
* Participate in site support activities when required.

**Maintenance Engineering**

* Develop preventive and corrective maintenance plans.
* Analyze failures, incidents, and system performance data.
* Support root cause analysis (RCA) and reliability improvement initiatives.
* Define spare parts strategies and lifecycle support plans.
* Contribute to RAMS (Reliability, Availability, Maintainability and Safety) calculations / demonstrations
* Support maintenance optimization and asset management initiatives.

**Technical Documentation**

* Prepare technical reports, maintenance plans, maintenance manuals, method statements, and service documentation.
* Maintain configuration and technical records.
* Ensure documentation compliance with customer and organizational standards.

**Customer & Stakeholder Management**

* Interface with customers, suppliers, subcontractors, and internal stakeholders.
* Participate in bid meetings, technical review meetings and project discussions.
* Support customer presentations and technical workshops.

**Quality, Safety & Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with tender requirements, railway Telecom standards and safety requirements.
* Support quality audits and process improvement initiatives.
* Follow company EHS and quality management procedures.

**System Knowledge On Below Key Subsystems Is Required**
**Transmission & Networking**

* Fiber Optic Communication Systems
* Network Management Systems (NMS)
* Redundant Telecom Architectures

**Operational Communication Systems**

* Train Radio Systems
* TETRA Communication Systems
* LTE / FRMCS knowledge (preferred)
* GSM-R Systems

**Information Systems**

* Passenger Information Systems (PIS)
* Public Address Systems (PA)
* Passenger Information Display Systems (PIDS)
* Voice Recording Systems

**Security & Surveillance**

* CCTV Systems
* Video Management Systems (VMS)
* Access Control Systems
* Intrusion Detection Systems

**Control & Monitoring**

* SCADA Communication Interfaces
* Telecom Monitoring Systems
* Network Performance Monitoring Tools

**Desired Skills**

* Bachelor's Degree in Electronics / Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering
* 8-10 years of experience in railway Telecom systems, maintenance engineering, service engineering, or Telecom projects.
* Experience in maintenance and service bid preparation is required.
* Exposure to metro, mainline, or urban rail Telecom projects is required.
* Experience working in multicultural and global project environments is an advantage.

**Join us and be yourself!**
We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us.

We're Siemens. A collection of over 379,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. title: MCU Networking & Diagnostics Engineer (TT610ST RM 4527)
description:
**Position: MCU Networking & Diagnostics Engineer (TT610ST RM 4527)**
**Automotive MCU / Networking & Diagnostics**
**Role Purpose**
Design, develop, integrate, and validate MCU-based automotive communication and diagnostic software, ensuring robust vehicle-network connectivity, standards-compliant diagnostics, reliable fault handling, and traceable delivery across ECU programs.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and configure MCU communication stacks for CAN, CAN FD, LIN, Ethernet, SOME/IP, and transport protocols based on project architecture.
* Develop and integrate diagnostic services using UDS, DoIP, OBD, DTC management, diagnostic sessions, security access, and routine control.
* Configure AUTOSAR communication and diagnostic modules, including COM, PduR, CanIf, CanTp, Dcm, Dem, NvM interfaces, and Ethernet-related services where applicable.
* Translate customer signal databases, diagnostic specifications, and network descriptions into maintainable software configurations and interface contracts.
* Implement network management, wake-up and sleep handling, communication control, timeout supervision, bus-off recovery, and degraded-mode behavior.
* Perform bench, SIL, HIL, and vehicle-level debugging using traces, bus logs, diagnostic logs, and MCU runtime measurements.
* Ensure bidirectional traceability from networking and diagnostic requirements through design, implementation, configuration, and verification evidence.
* Coordinate with system, BSW, application, validation, cybersecurity, and customer teams to resolve interface issues and deliver production-ready releases

**Required Experience And Competencies**

* Strong embedded C development and debugging experience on automotive microcontrollers.
* Hands-on knowledge of CAN, CAN FD, LIN, Ethernet, SOME/IP, DoIP, UDS, ISO-TP, OBD, and vehicle network management concepts.
* Experience with AUTOSAR Classic communication and diagnostic BSW configuration, integration, and issue analysis.
* Ability to interpret DBC, ARXML, ODX, CDD, diagnostic extracts, signal matrices, and customer interface specifications.
* Proficiency with bus analyzers, debuggers, diagnostic testers, oscilloscopes, and log-analysis methods.
* Good understanding of ASPICE engineering practices, functional safety awareness, cybersecurity constraints, and disciplined defect resolution

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Vector CANoe, CANalyzer, CANape, DaVinci Configurator/Developer, EB tresos, or equivalent automotive tools.
* Exposure to bootloaders, secure diagnostics, OTA or flash programming, Ethernet test tools, scripting, and test automation.

**Education**
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, Automotive Engineering, or a related discipline. Equivalent relevant industry experience may also be considered.
  
  
**Expected Leadership Behaviors**

* Own networking and diagnostic delivery outcomes with clear interface governance, risk communication, and timely escalation.
* Promote reusable configurations, coding discipline, peer reviews, automation, and evidence-based engineering decisions.
* Coach engineers in protocol analysis, systematic debugging, customer communication, and cross-domain issue resolution

title: System Engineer - Signalling Services
description:
**Hello Visionary!**
We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make an outstanding addition to our vibrant team. Siemens Mobility is an independent run company of Siemens AG. Its core business includes rail vehicles, rail automation and electrification solutions, turnkey systems, intelligent road traffic technology and related services. In Mobility, we help our customers meet the need for hard-working mobility solutions. We’re making the lives of people who travel easier and more enjoyable while constantly developing new, intelligent mobility solutions!
  
  
**We are looking for System Engineer - Signalling Services**
The System Engineer - Signalling Services is responsible for supporting local and global service bids, maintenance contracts, and project execution activities related to railway signalling systems
  
  
The position demands strong system level technical expertise in various modern metro signaling technologies like CBTC / ETCS / IxL, etc and a thorough understanding of Railway technical requirements / system requirement specifications.
  
  
The role involves maintenance engineering, system analysis, technical bid preparation, lifecycle support, cost estimation, documentation, and coordination with cross-functional teams to deliver competitive and compliant signalling service solutions.
  
  
The system engineer will contribute to preventive, corrective, and condition-based maintenance strategies while ensuring adherence to customer requirements, railway standards, safety regulations, and company processes.
  
  
**You’ll make a difference by**

* Conduct technical discussions with all stakeholders.
* Act as a problem solver while ensuring compliance with applicable railway standards and project requirements.
* Act as Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for signaling service system engineering, ensuring clear communication and alignment with stakeholders.

**Bid & Tender Support**

* Analyze customer requirements, technical specifications, and tender documents.
* Support preparation of technical service proposals for signaling maintenance and service contracts.
* Develop maintenance concepts, staffing models, maintenance plans, and service strategies.
* Estimate service workload, spare parts requirements, tools, and asset lifecycle costs.
* Support cost calculations, risk assessments, and bid reviews.
* Coordinate with engineering, procurement, finance, operations, and commercial teams during bid preparation.

**Project Support**

* Prepare maintenance documentation, procedures, and work instructions.
* Monitor project deliverables, milestones, and technical compliance.
* Support system modifications, upgrades, migrations, and obsolescence management activities.
