* Develop preventive and corrective maintenance plans.
* Analyze failures, incidents, and system performance data.
* Support root cause analysis (RCA) and reliability improvement initiatives.
* Define spare parts strategies and lifecycle support plans.
* Contribute to RAMS (Reliability, Availability, Maintainability and Safety) calculations / demonstrations
* Support maintenance optimization and asset management initiatives.

**Technical Documentation**

* Prepare technical reports, maintenance plans, maintenance manuals, method statements, and service documentation.
* Maintain configuration and technical records.
* Ensure documentation compliance with customer and organizational standards.

**Customer & Stakeholder Management**

* Interface with customers, suppliers, subcontractors, and internal stakeholders.
* Participate in bid meetings, technical review meetings and project discussions.
* Support customer presentations and technical workshops.

**Quality, Safety & Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with tender requirements, railway signalling standards and safety requirements.
* Support quality audits and process improvement initiatives.
* Follow company EHS and quality management procedures.

**System Knowledge On Below Key Subsystems Is Required**

* Interlocking Systems (Electronic/Computer Based Interlocking)
* Track circuits, Axle counters, Point machines, Level crossing systems
* Signals and route control systems
* Centralized Traffic Control (CTC)
* Automatic Train Protection (ATP) systems
* Onboard and Wayside signaling equipment
* Communication-Based Train Control (CBTC)
* ETCS Level 2 system

**Desired Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical, Electronics or Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering
* 8-10 years of experience in railway signalling systems, maintenance engineering, service engineering, or signalling projects.
* Experience in maintenance and service bid preparation is required.
* Exposure to metro, mainline, or urban rail signalling projects is required.
* Experience working in multicultural and global project environments is an advantage.

title: PMT - Product Validation Lead
description:

We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
PMT - Product Validation Lead
  
  
Who is Mastercard?
  
  
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
  
  
Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
  
  
**Overview**
Payments Network Technology is seeking a Product Management Technical professional to lead product validation and payment-domain outcomes. The role connects customer and business needs with engineering delivery, test coverage, and release acceptance.
  
  
Roles and Responsibilities
  
  

* Own the vision, working-backwards narrative, and measurable outcomes for assigned capabilities.
* Translate customer, operational, and business needs into prioritized features, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Make and communicate trade-off recommendations across scope, depth, timelines, risk, and technical investment.
* Coordinate requirements and dependencies with engineering, architecture, testing, operations, and customer-facing teams.
* Review demonstrations and validation evidence against acceptance criteria before release.
* Maintain clear product documentation and use production or validation metrics as feedback into the backlog.
* Identify feature-level delivery or customer risks and drive prioritization and resolution.
* Define validation strategy for authorization, clearing, tokenization, ISO 8583, and ISO 20022 payment flows.
* Support defect triage and confirm that resolved behavior meets payment-processing requirements.
* Provide technical or product leadership, mentor team members, and drive decisions across multiple workstreams.

**Essential Skills**

* Experience in technical product management, product ownership, business analysis, or payment-product validation.
* Knowledge of payment transaction flows and message standards such as ISO 8583 and ISO 20022.
* Ability to work with engineers and architects on APIs, data models, non-functional requirements, and operational behavior.
* Data-driven decision-making and strong product documentation skills.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

**All About You**

* Experience working in Agile delivery environments and across the software development lifecycle.
* Clear communication, collaboration, problem-solving, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to work with globally distributed product, engineering, architecture, operations, and business teams.
* Experience applying AI-driven product validation to improve efficiency, expand coverage, and identify defects earlier in the development lifecycle.
* Payments or financial-services domain knowledge is preferred.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Senior GRC Engineer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!
  
  
We are seeking Senior GRC Engineer to design, scale, and automate security governance, risk, and compliance frameworks. In this role, you will bridge the gap between compliance requirements and technical execution by automation for frameworks like NIST and ISO standards, building standardized control libraries, mapping multi-standard frameworks, and driving audit readiness.
  
  
If you have a strong foundation in risk management frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001/2) and an engineering-minded approach to control implementation and evidence automation, you will thrive in this position.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Framework Architecture & Control Management
* Design Control Libraries: Build and maintain scalable, reusable security and compliance control libraries across the organization.
* Framework Mapping: Translate complex regulatory and industry standards into standardized, actionable control definitions.
* Risk & Policy Alignment: Map evidence requirements across overlapping compliance frameworks to eliminate redundancy and support the ISO & NIST Risk Management Frameworks.
* Compliance Automation & Evidence Engineering
* Evidence Modeling: Define standardized evidence artifacts, validation logic, and assessment criteria for automated control evaluation.
* Engineering Collaboration: Partner with engineering and security teams to build automated evidence collection pipelines and continuous compliance monitoring.
* Data-Driven GRC: Build compliance content and metadata rule libraries using structured data formats (JSON/YAML) to scale platform capabilities.
* Audit Readiness & Framework Implementation
* NIST & ISO Implementation: Drive the practical design, implementation, and mapping of NIST (CSF / SP 800-53 / RMF / SOC 2) and ISO 27001/27002 control frameworks across technical environments.
* Assessment Guidance: Define clear implementation guidance, control validation criteria, and self-assessment objectives for technical teams.
* Continuous Improvement: Continuously refine GRC workflows, tooling, and framework content as standards and organizational needs evolve.

**Qualifications & Skills:**
**Required Experience**

* Framework Implementation: Required hands-on experience implementing, operationalizing, and mapping ISO 27001/27002 and NIST SP 800-53 / NIST CSF / NIST RMF frameworks. Experience with PCI DSS, SOC 2, and CIS Controls is a strong plus.
* Audit Readiness: Demonstrated ability to prepare technical environments and control owners for external audits through structured evidence management and control readiness models.
* Risk Management: Deep understanding of ISO and NIST Risk Management Frameworks, including risk assessment methodologies, control testing, and remediation workflows.
* Technical Aptitude: Understanding cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), Identity & Access Management (IAM), and core security technologies.
* Data & Automation: Experience working with structured data formats (JSON, YAML) to define validation logic or control metadata.
* Evidence Management: Familiarity with evidence mapping, automated evidence validation, and modern compliance testing concepts.

**Professional Competencies**

* Analytical Thinking: Ability to decompose complex regulatory texts into clear, practical engineering specifications.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Excellent technical communication skills with the ability to bridge conversations between technical engineers, product teams, and management.
* Documentation & Precision: High attention to detail in defining control definitions, test procedures, and architectural mappings.

**Preferred Qualifications (Bonus)**

* Industry certifications such as CISA, CRISC, CISM, or CISSP.
* Hands-on experience with GRC automation platforms (e.g., ServiceNow GRC, Vanta, Drata, Anecdotes, or custom GRC platforms).
* Background in software engineering, security engineering, or compliance automation.

Northern Trust is looking for an Associate to join its Technology Development Center in Pune, India.
  
  
**Job Description AND Principal Responsibilities**
The Vulnerability Management Associate is a technical support role within the Vulnerability Management function, providing day-to-day platform administration, technical analysis, data validation, integration monitoring, testing, reporting, and support for enterprise Vulnerability Management technologies.
  
  
This role works closely with VM Engineers to provide day-to-day technical support across the Vulnerability Management technology ecosystem, with a focus on platform monitoring, troubleshooting, data quality, integration support, testing, reporting, and continuous improvement.
  
  
The role will support technologies including Qualys, Zafran Security, Wiz, Aqua Security, ServiceNow integrations, Policy Compliance, and Attack Surface Management capabilities.
  
  
**Principal Responsibilities/Requirements**

* Provide day-to-day technical and platform support for Qualys, Zafran, Wiz, Aqua Security, and associated integrations.
* Monitor platform health, scanning activity, integrations, data feeds, API jobs, asset coverage, and data completeness.
* Perform initial troubleshooting of scanner, agent, authentication, API, integration, and data-ingestion issues and escalate complex engineering issues to VM Engineers.
* Support Qualys scanner and agent operations, including scan status, authentication results, failed scans, coverage, and troubleshooting.
* Support Qualys Policy Compliance activities, including policy/profile maintenance, control mapping, authentication issues, configuration assessments, and reporting.
* Support Wiz cloud-security and configuration-compliance capabilities, including validation of findings, coverage, data feeds, and integrations.
* Support Aqua and Kubernetes/container security platforms, including monitoring scanning coverage, image/registry/cluster data, integrations, and platform issues.
* Monitor Zafran data ingestion and enrichment from connected security technologies and identify missing, stale, or inconsistent data.
* Validate that vulnerability, asset, threat, exposure, and compensating-control information is flowing correctly into Zafran.
* Support and test Zafran AI agent use cases and automation opportunities identified by VM Engineering.
* Assist VM Engineers with testing and validation of Python/API automation and ServiceNow workflow changes.
* Monitor ServiceNow integrations to ensure vulnerability records, assignments, enrichment, status updates, and closure information are flowing correctly between systems.
* Investigate integration failures, incorrect assignments, missing enrichment, duplicate records, asset-matching issues, and other data-quality problems.
* Support Attack Surface Management by validating discovered assets, investigating ownership and attribution data, and ensuring ASM information flows appropriately into downstream VM platforms.
* Perform UAT/testing and validation for platform upgrades, configuration changes, integrations, new automation, and new security capabilities.
* Assist VM Engineers with POCs, implementations, platform migrations, and integration testing.
* Produce platform-support reporting covering scanner health, coverage, integration status, failed jobs, data quality, enrichment, and other engineering metrics.
* Maintain platform inventories, configurations, support documentation, knowledge articles, procedures, and runbooks.
* Work closely with VM Engineering to identify recurring support issues that should be permanently resolved through engineering or automation.
* Work with VM Operations when platform or data issues affect their remediation processes, while leaving vulnerability remediation ownership with the existing VM Operations team.

Skill / Experience
  
  
**Minimum**

* Experience supporting Vulnerability Management, Security Engineering, Security Platforms, or Cybersecurity Operations technologies.
* Working knowledge of Qualys, Zafran, Wiz, Aqua Security, ServiceNow, ASM, or comparable technologies.
* Understanding of vulnerability scanning, authenticated scanning, agents, asset inventory, and Policy Compliance/configuration assessment.
* Familiarity with cloud, Kubernetes, containers, Linux, Windows, networking, and enterprise infrastructure.
* Basic knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, scripting, and automation concepts; Python experience is preferred.
* Ability to troubleshoot data feeds, integrations, authentication, scanning, coverage, and platform issues.
* Understanding of ServiceNow/CMDB integrations and vulnerability workflows.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to investigate large datasets and identify coverage, enrichment, integration, and data-quality issues.
* Ability to work closely with engineers and learn complex enterprise security technologies.
* Experience supporting security technologies within a large enterprise environment preferred.

**Preferred**

* 5-8 years of relevant experience
* Any infosec certifications or related (desired, not a compulsion)

**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Pune Office**
The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
  
  
Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

title: Technical SAP Signavio Architect/Techno-Functional Consultant
description:
**About the Role**

Job Description: Technical SAP Signavio Architect/Techno-Functional ConsultantPosition OverviewWe are seeking a highly skilled SAP Signavio Tecno-Functional Consultant with extensive hands-on technical capabilities to lead end-to-end business process transformation, optimization, and process mining initiatives. Unlike traditional functional roles, this position demands a deep understanding of data architectures, systems integration, and hands-on technical development.The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between business operations and technical data engineering, actively building data pipelines, profiling source data, setting up complex system integrations via SAP BTP, and writing advanced queries to power operational dashboards and process intelligence metrics.

**Responsibilities**

* Key Responsibilities
* 1. Module-Specific Functional Management
* SAP Signavio Process Manager: Establish and enforce workspace modeling conventions, govern the central corporate Dictionary for reusable business terms/objects, and model end-to-end process hierarchies using BPMN 2.0 and DMN (Decision Model and Notation). Conduct process simulations and perform structured "As-Is" vs. "To-Be" diagram comparisons to evaluate impact.
* SAP Signavio Process Insights: Configure rapid connections to core SAP ERP/S/4HANA instances to gain immediate, automated visibility into business processes. Analyze standard out-of-the-box performance indicators (such as automation rates, backlogs, and throughput), interpret industry benchmarking data, and execute standard correction or innovation recommendations.
* SAP Signavio Process Intelligence: Lead advanced process mining discovery initiatives across multi-system environments. Execute detailed conformance checks to analyze actual execution against standard target models, and identify process execution leakage including compliance violations, unwanted loops, and manual workarounds.
* 2. Process Mining & Data Profiling (Technical Hands-on)
* Perform exhaustive data profiling and structural data analysis across SAP and non-SAP source environments to validate data quality and completeness before process ingestion.
* Design, build, and maintain data ingestion pipelines for SAP Signavio Process Intelligence, mapping transactional data to event logs (Case ID, Activity, Timestamp).
* Identify data anomalies, concurrency issues, and gaps in transactional logs, implementing robust transformations to resolve them.
* 3. Integration & SAP BTP Engineering
* Configure, establish, and optimize secure data connections between SAP Signavio and various backend applications (including third-party ERPs, CRMs, legacy databases, and cloud services).
* Leverage SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) for enterprise integration, data orchestration, data federation, and custom extension developments.
* Implement API-based integrations and utilize JDBC/ODBC connectors, secure file transfers, and cloud ingestion agents to capture real-time or batch transactional records.
* 4. Query Development & Analytics
* Write, debug, and optimize complex queries using SIGNAL (Signavio Process Mining Query Language) and standard SQL to extract process insights and calculate critical KPIs.
* Develop advanced process dashboards, custom metrics, and automated alerts within SAP Signavio Process Intelligence to expose process bottlenecks, variations, and compliance violations.
* Build predictive metrics and custom logic to track process behavior and trigger operational actions based on data patterns.
* 5. Process Modeling & Functional Analysis
* Lead collaborative process discovery workshops with business stakeholders to model "As-Is" and "To-Be" business processes using BPMN 2.0 standards within SAP Signavio Process Manager.
* Translate analytical findings from process mining into actionable business optimization strategies, collaborating with functional process owners.
* Align custom developments with standard SAP Best Practices and Signavio Value Accelerators to accelerate digital transformation milestones (e.g., SAP S/4HANA migrations).



**Qualifications**

* Required Technical & Functional QualificationsExperience: Minimum of 5 to 10 years of professional experience in Business Process Management (BPM) and Process Mining, with at least 5 years of direct, hands-on technical implementation experience using the SAP Signavio Suite.

**Required Skills**

* Functional Competencies:
* Extensive knowledge of Process Manager, including business architecture design, simulation setups, and DMN decision tables.
* Deep proficiency in Process Insights, including setting up automated data extractions, analyzing standard process flows, tracking master data categories, and navigating the Variant Explorer.
* Masterful command of Process Intelligence functional configurations, identifying root causes, managing metrics, and aligning data-driven findings with stakeholders.
* Signavio Toolset Mastery: Proven expertise across SAP Signavio Process Intelligence (specifically the ETL layer), Process Manager, and Collaboration Hub.
* Database & Query Skills: Exceptional proficiency in writing complex queries in standard SQL and SIGNAL. Deep understanding of relational database management systems (RDBMS), data warehousing concepts, and schema design.
* SAP BTP & Middleware: Practical, hands-on experience using SAP BTP for data integration, orchestration, or application deployment. Familiarity with SAP Integration Suite (Cloud Integration) is highly advantageous.
* Third-Party Integrations: Demonstrated track record connecting Signavio to non-SAP systems (e.g., Salesforce, ServiceNow, Oracle, or custom legacy databases) via REST/SOAP APIs and standard database connectors.
* Data Engineering: Experience in ETL/ELT development, data profiling tools, data cleansing methodology, and transforming raw transactional tables into event logs.



**Preferred Skills**

* Preferred Professional QualificationsPreferred - Official certification in SAP SignavioPrior functional experience in core enterprise process cycles such as Order-to-Cash (O2C), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), or Record-to-Report (R2R).Experience assisting organizations through large-scale migrations from SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA using process mining insights.
* Core Soft SkillsStrong analytical and problem-solving mindset capable of drilling down into low-level data anomalies while maintaining a high-level operational perspective.Excellent communication and presentation skills, with a proven ability to translate complex technical data structures into clear business insights for executive stakeholders.Comfortable working in agile, fast-paced environments with cross-functional global teams.

We are currently seeking an experienced DFM / Project Engineer to join our Pune team. This is a full-time (40 hours/week), onsite position for candidates with a proven background in DFM, SolidWorks, and manufacturing.

**Before applying, read this posting in full.**
This role requires attending an
**in-person interview and a hands-on DFM test at our Pune office (approx 60-75 mins),**
there is no remote or take-home option. If you are not willing and able to do this, please do not apply. You will only waste your time and ours.

Please note:

* This is an in-person role based in Pune, India.
* No relocation assistance is provided. You must already be based in Pune. Applications from other cities will not be considered.
* No remote, no hybrid, no students. We don’t have work-from-home policies.
* Only experienced professionals will be considered.
* This is an urgent hire. We are prioritizing candidates who can join immediately or within 30 days or less.
* Candidates with a notice period of more than 30 days will not be considered. If you cannot start within 30 days, do not apply; no exceptions will be made. Do not waste our time.
* Our selection process is fully in person: a face-to-face interview and a hands-on DFM test completed on-site at our Pune office. There is no remote or take-home test — you must be able and willing to attend in person.
* Do not send connection requests or direct messages on LinkedIn. We will reach out to candidates who are a fit; unsolicited messages will be ignored.
* A work portfolio is mandatory. Applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed. Include examples of DFM analyses, SolidWorks models, technical drawings, or relevant engineering work you have completed

**Position Summary**

You will be responsible for managing the transition of products from design to mass production, ensuring designs are optimized for manufacturability across a wide variety of processes including injection molding, CNC machining, sheet metal fabrication, die casting, and assembly.

You will work closely with our industrial design and engineering teams across India, China, and Southeast Asia, and occasionally support communication with international clients and vendors.

**Selection Process**

* Shortlisted candidates will be invited to our Pune office for a face-to-face interview.
* As part of the process, you will complete a practical DFM test on-site at our office, reviewing drawings, recommending manufacturability improvements, and presenting your findings. The test is done in person; there is no take-home or remote option.
* Please be prepared to attend in person and demonstrate your skills live. Candidates unwilling or unable to come on-site will not be progressed.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Perform detailed DFM analysis and recommend improvements for manufacturability, cost-efficiency, and scalability.
* Create and revise 3D CAD models and 2D drawings using SolidWorks, with appropriate use of GD&T and tolerance stack-ups.
* Generate production-ready technical documentation (BOMs, engineering drawings, assembly specs, etc.).
* Coordinate with internal teams and external suppliers for prototyping, tooling, and production execution.
* Evaluate supplier feedback on design feasibility, tooling challenges, and cost breakdowns.
* Support factory interactions including calls, visits, and documentation updates as needed.
* Maintain clear revision history and version control across all technical documentation.
* Monitor project timelines and proactively flag risks, misalignments, or bottlenecks.
* Assist quality control and production teams with testing plans and failure analysis.
* Remain open and available for international travel across our offices, this is not guaranteed but may be requested.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or equivalent.
* Minimum 2 years of hands-on, post-graduation proven experience in product engineering, manufacturing, or DFM-focused roles.
* Expert-level proficiency in SolidWorks (modeling, drafting, assemblies, GD&T).
* Proven knowledge of DFM principles for various processes: injection molding, CNC, die casting, sheet metal, and assembly.
* Experience preparing detailed production documentation and working with manufacturers or suppliers.
* Strong mechanical fundamentals, practical problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.
* Excellent organizational and communication skills, fluent English required both written and spoken.

**Nice to Have**

* Familiarity with secondary CAD/visualization tools (e.g., Fusion 360, KeyShot, AutoCAD).
* Experience working with international clients or cross-functional remote teams.
* Knowledge of product compliance and testing standards (ROHS, CE, etc.).
* Exposure to ERP/project tracking tools.

**Important Application Notice**

We value genuine, thoughtful applications. Submissions generated by AI tools will be detected and rejected. We are looking for real humans with real experience, not generic buzzword filled CVs.

You’d be surprised how often this happens, please don’t waste your time or ours.

* Implement digital best practice, improve existing customer experience and drive financial growth with a focus on platform consolidation.
* Use data driven insights to reduce customer friction across our portfolio of websites and mobile apps.
* Provide regular analytical reporting and recommendations based on data.
* Partnering with and supporting regional team (Marketing, Product and Sales in particular) to advise on best practice digital execution and instigate change for the better.

* The role requires someone with a strong all-round approach to digital; ranging from content management, launching of new features/functionality in production and a strong desire to innovate and learn from the ecommerce industry.
* Identifies issues that will keep the platform features from delivering on time and/or with the desired requirements and works with internal teams and customer service to identify, classify, and prioritize feature-level customer issues.

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: UAV electronic system engineer
description:
Job Description – UAV Electronics & Communications Systems Engineer

Enhansafe India Pvt. Ltd.

**Position:**
UAV Electronics & Communications Systems Engineer
**Department:**
UAV / Unmanned Systems
**Location:**
Pune, Maharashtra (with travel across India and abroad)
**Experience:**
Minimum 3 years of hands-on UAV or related electronics experience

About Enhansafe

Enhansafe India Pvt. Ltd. is a deeptech defence and homeland security company building unmanned aerial systems and domestic drone platforms, alongside counter-drone, surveillance, perimeter security and unmanned surface vessel solutions. As a registered defence vendor, we work on mission-critical systems where reliability, security and discipline are non-negotiable.

Role Summary

We are looking for an electronics engineer who can own the electrical and communications backbone of our UAV platforms, from power distribution and battery management to RF links, telemetry, video and payload data, onboard networking and secure communications. You will design, integrate, test and field-support systems used in demanding operational environments.

Key Responsibilities

•      Design and validate power distribution architectures and battery management systems for multirotor and fixed-wing UAVs.

•      Develop and integrate communication, telemetry, and video and payload data links, including link-budget planning and range optimisation.

•      Design onboard networking and carry out end-to-end system integration of avionics, payloads and ground control systems.

•      Carry out RF engineering and antenna design, selection, placement and testing.

•      Implement communication security and resilience measures, including encryption, anti-jamming and fail-safe link behaviour.

•      Run bench, ground and flight tests; analyse data; troubleshoot and resolve electronics and RF issues in the field.

•      Prepare schematics, wiring harness documentation, test reports and technical SOPs.

•      Support demonstrations, customer trials and deployments across India and, when required, overseas.

Required Technical Expertise

The candidate must be well versed in all of the following areas, with project experience in each:

1.     Power distribution

2.     Battery management systems

3.     Communications and telemetry systems

4.     Video and payload data transmission

5.     Onboard networking and system integration

6.     RF engineering and antenna design

7.     Communication security and resilience

Qualifications and Experience

•      B.E./B.Tech (or higher) in Electronics, Electronics & Telecommunication, Electrical, Instrumentation or a related discipline.

•      Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in UAV, avionics, RF or embedded electronics.

•      Proven, hands-on involvement in projects covering the seven areas listed above.

•      Proficiency with schematic and PCB tools, RF test equipment (spectrum analyser, VNA, power meters) and standard lab instruments.

•      Good documentation and communication skills; able to work independently and in a team.

Selection Criteria

Past project experience in the listed areas is the key criterion for selection. Applicants must state their experience in
**each**
area separately in the application, naming the project, their role and the outcome.

Area

Applicant must mention

Power distribution

Projects, systems and your role

Battery management systems

Projects, systems and your role

Communications and telemetry

Projects, systems and your role

Video and payload data transmission

Projects, systems and your role

Onboard networking and system integration

Projects, systems and your role

RF engineering and antenna design

Projects, systems and your role

Communication security and resilience

Projects, systems and your role

Applications that do not address each area will not be shortlisted.

Location and Travel

•      Based in Pune, Maharashtra.

•      Travel across India is expected for projects, field trials and demonstrations.

•      Foreign travel may be required; a valid passport is mandatory.

How to Apply

Email your application to
**Directorops@enhansafe.com**
with the subject line "Application – UAV Electronics & Communications Systems Engineer". Include:

1.     Your CV and a covering note stating your experience in each of the seven technical areas.

2.     Salary slips (recent).

3.     Achievements and awards.

4.     White papers, publications or technical write-ups, if any.

5.     Copy of a valid passport.

Only applications with complete documents and area-wise experience statements will be considered.

Senior Project Analyst - Asset Servicing is responsible for the accurate and timely processing a range of different corporate event types across multiple markets. The department interfaces directly with the local market entities including depositary, counterparts and regulators as well as other Citi lines of business, internal and external clients. The Citi Asset Servicing department is a varied, fast paced, challenging & enjoyable place to work which has something for everyone.
  
  
The team is the initial contact point for operational & Product development requests and business analysis. The team produces/reviews BRDs (Business Requirements Document) & FRDs (Functional Requirements Document), manages UAT (User Acceptance Testing) and coordinates implementation of new developments.
  
  
The successful candidate will be required to have a strong and detailed understanding of end-to-end operations and act as a client advocate. You will be required to interface with internal stakeholders at a senior level, acting as escalation point as well as a strategic business partner.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Understanding the Operating Model to be able to advise all stakeholders on the impact of any change of the model.
* Assist the Project Manager with the co-ordination of release planning, execution and post-implementation review.
* Working with technology and product colleagues to develop a robust, stable and scalable solution.
* Understand Business Requirement Documents and support testing of solutions.
* Create Business Scenarios for testing through own knowledge and leveraging the knowledge of Operations specialists.
* Leading BRD and FRD walkthroughs with multiple stakeholders.
* Ensure all solutions are appropriately documented and communicated to impacted parties.
* Ensure that core Operations staff ready for the implementation.
* Work with the Project Manager to ensure all project documentation is in place, updated and in good order.
* Work with the Project Manager to communicate to stakeholders/senior management the status of a project.
* Carry out test planning and test execution for key Asset Servicing projects

**Skills And Experience**

* Asset Servicing / Custody Product knowledge.
* Analytical skills.
* Good attention to detail, excellent organizational skills.
* Proven ability to operate and deliver to deadlines.
* Project work or Business Analysis experience is a plus.
* Proven success as a team player.

**Qualifications:**

* 2-5 years relevant experience

**Education:**

* Must have 2-5 years relevant banking experience in Asset Servicing
* BA/UAT experience preferred
* Knowledge of multiple types of investment instruments including: Equity securities, Fixed Income and Asset Backed securities
* Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, Access- is desired)
* Proven success as a team player

This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.

title: Project Engineer
description:
**Bring more to life.**
Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?
  
  
At Cytiva, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.
  
  
You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.
  
  
Working at Cytiva means being at the forefront of providing new solutions to transform human health. Our incredible customers undertake life-saving activities ranging from fundamental biological research to developing innovative vaccines, new medicines, and cell and gene therapies.
  
  
At Cytiva you will be able to continuously improve yourself and us – working on challenges that truly matter with people that care for each other, our customers, and their patients. Take your next step to an altogether life-changing career.
  
  
Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.
  
  
The
**Project Engineer**
is responsible for execution of customer projects & standard platform products from order receipt through design, manufacturing, testing, documentation, and shipment. The role serves as the technical focal point for assigned projects and Products works closely with Global Engineering, Project Management, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Quality, and Suppliers to ensure projects & products are delivered on time, within budget, and in compliance with Cytiva quality standards.
  
  
This position is part of the Custom Engineering organization located in
**Pune**
and will be an on-site role. At Cytiva, our vision is, to advance future therapeutics from discovery to delivery.
  
  
**What Will You Do**

* Review of customer specifications and project requirements.
* Lead technical execution from kick-off through shipment.
* Coordinate engineering deliverables, schedules & inventories
* Support manufacturing, Inspection , FAT, documentation, and compliance activities.
* Act as technical interface between customers and internal stakeholders.
* Drive continuous improvement using DBS principles.

**Who Are You**

* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, Chemical, or related discipline. 3 to 8 years of relevant project engineering experience
* Experience in life sciences, biopharma, filtration systems, skids, process equipment or capital projects. Knowledge of skid manufacturing, piping, instrumentation, and welding.
* Experience in P&IDs, GA drawings, fabrication drawings.
* Knowledge in ERP systems such as Oracle or SAP.
* Knowledge in CAD tools such as AutoCAD, SolidWorks, or Inventor.

Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.
  
  
For more information, visit www.danaher.com.

title: Project Engineer – Electrical Hardware
description:
**Position Summary**
Husco International provides individuals with the opportunity to pursue a career within a fast-paced, industry-leading and entrepreneurial organization. This person works within an engineering team and is responsible for supporting the organization with the new and existing products, analysis, tools, and designs. This person collaborates internally and externally with multi-disciplined teams to help envision, create, modify, test, document, validate, design, debug and produce electrical hardware solutions. A person in this role enjoys developing elegant hardware/software solutions through understanding customer needs, industry standards, and existing and novel electrical approaches. They also have strong technical background in moving electrical hardware from concept to production and beyond.
  
  
Husco is committed to building a diverse environment for employees to be able:
  
  

* To have the flexibility to put a personal ‘stamp’ on their work
* To continuously expand and develop their professional skills, knowledge, and career
* To create a product for our customers that serves a greater purpose to communities around the world

**PERFORMANCE OBJECTIVES:**- Rapid Learning and Skill Development: Embrace a steep learning curve to rapidly expand product knowledge, abilities, and toolkit (e.g., Altium Designer, Electrical SPICE simulation, industry standards (IPC, ISO, etc.), debugging, testing, Agile development methods) to apply to electrical hardware design and validations from concept to production.
- End-to-End Electrical Hardware Support: Utilize your expertise to efficiently turn engineering requirements into reality. Collaborate with PCB fabrication and assembly manufacturing, test labs, component suppliers, engineering labs, software engineers, and internal/external customers throughout the development process, from early development to production and beyond.
Expertise in Power Electronics Hardware: Demonstrate proficiency in PCB design for low power electronic hardware such as solenoid and motor control (<60V, <50A). This includes designing for EMC, ESD, thermal, noise, etc. Showcase experience in components selection and robust PCB layout. Design and select hardware suitable for automotive and off-highway markets. Utilize cutting-edge software (e.g., Altium, Ansys, Amesim, ICEPak). Conduct testing, validation, and documentation for production- Deep Understanding of Electrical power and communication systems. Utilize your knowledge of software, mechanical, and electrical domains to set up simulations, firmware, component tests, systems tests, and modifications of a PCBA. Leverage your expertise to break down electrical systems into underlying components and circuits, proposing, implementing, testing, writing software, and validating function/fit with respect to requirements.
- Strong Team Player and Contributor. Able to work well with colleagues and produce results within a fast-paced and high-pressure atmosphere. Combine a balance of attention to detail and complete work within project timelines while complying with process, quality, safety, and communication expectations.
**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor of Electrical Engineering major or equivalent
* 4+ years of work experience and demonstrated proficiency in embedded PCB power electronics, board design, board layout, testing, board rework/soldering, and debugging
* Demonstrated proficiency in simulation of electronic circuits
* Demonstrated proficiency in Altium Designer, including use of version control, libraries, templates, etc.
* Capability to interpret and create schematics, circuits, requirements documents, datasheets, test plans, and DFMEAs
* Understanding of Electrical requirements of mobile equipment (EMC, ESD, vibration, Load dump, etc..) and how to read, understand, design for, test, and validate conformity to applicable standards
* Strong oral, written and listening communication skills
* Ability to work independently and within a group.

**NICE TO HAVE:**

* Experience in C programming and MCU development tools writing embedded software, drivers, communication protocols (CAN, SPI, etc.) firmware, test infrastructure for embedded hardware
* Experience in working with stakeholders (internal, suppliers, test house, customer) to launch product
* Experience and interest in Siemens Simcenter Amesim Physical modeling product
* Interest in learning other coding languages and processes
* Experience in functional safety and security standards and processes
* Experience/interest in Electrical Hardware functional safety and security requirements / standards
* Experience/interest in working with Electrical component and assembly manufacturers from concept to test, to production and obsolescence
* Knowledge of the software development lifecycle
* Experience in writing software requirements, test plans, and documentation
* Comfortable with the analysis and able to break down large control systems into smaller component level systems
* Ability to understand and develop complex control systems in the mechatronics, robotics, hydraulic, or similar within an embedded system environment.
* Proficient in Git Version control system

**Who We Are:**
Imagine a place where your career can soar, where innovation meets excellence, and where your contributions truly matter. Welcome to Husco.
  
  
Here, you’ll find the freedom to shape your work and leave a lasting impact. We believe in empowering you to grow personally and professionally, continuously enhancing your skills and knowledge.
  
  
Your role at Husco goes beyond the ordinary – you’ll be at the forefront of supporting teams that develop innovative hydraulic and electro-mechanical systems that enhance efficiency and performance. These products make a real difference globally, building the communities we live in, growing the food that feeds us, and enhancing transportation around the world.
  
  
Join our vibrant, industry-leading team and experience a culture that values your creativity, dedication, and drive. Together, we’re not just achieving goals; we’re setting new standards and making a positive impact every day.
  
  
**HUSCO IS PROUD TO BE AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER.**

title: SAP FICA Functional-SENIOR
description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Career Family: SAP Utilities**
**Role Type: Functional Consultant**
**The opportunity**
As part of our EY GDS-Utilities team, you will work to implement and support SAP IS-U projects for clients. You will get an opportunity to work with high quality team. You will get an opportunity to build innovating product which solves client’s problems.
  
  
We’re looking for Senior resources with expertise in
**SAP FI-CA**
to join the EYD GDS team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* To provide functional knowledge with hands-on experience in electricity, gas and water utilities.
* Hands on experience configuring the IS-U system
* Drive Business Workshops, Blueprint Sessions, develop BBPs/BBDs FS, Test Scenarios, conduct Trainings, perform Testing and provide defect management support for Device Management module
* Design core / customized business processes and provide best practices for ISU.
* Communicate complex requirements to and from Technical and Non-technical stakeholders
* Willing to travel as per requirement
* Monitors the progress and the quality of the project

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Should understand different business processes in the Utility Industry (Regulated and Deregulated)
* Should possess SAP FICA knowledge for preparation of business blueprints, business process plan (BPP), functional documents, and test cases etc.
* Should have knowledge of the Meter to Cash
* Should have experience in FICA Dunning procedure/Collection Strategy, payment (cash desk/external cash desk) integration with payment channels, write off, return processing, security deposit, installment plan, and promise to pay.
* Exposure of Country specific localization.
* Experience in BRIM CI FICA is good to have.
* Experience in configuring FICA Events and BRF+ (functional).
* Strong knowledge of clearing strategy, clearing rules.
* Experience in Cash Desk and clarifications.
* Strong knowledge of month-end and period-end closing and FICA to FICO GL integration.
* Experience in the de-regulated/Regulated energy market.
* Develop templates and methods to improve the efficiency of application support.
* Gather and prioritize relevant SAP Business requirements and designing the appropriate solution
* Understands configuration dependencies and inter-relationships between other modules of SAP such as Device Management, CS/CRM, Billing and design and troubleshoot in the area with this knowledge
* Define test scenarios to cover full scope of the business as well as creating master data and carry out the unit, cycle and integration tests
* Should be well versed to make enhancements in specific FICA events.
* Must have completed multiple SAP projects and have excellent communication skills
* Confidence working within an offshore/onshore delivery model
* Proven expedience large stream of work across multiple locations
* Consulting experience advantageous
* Strong hands-on experience on FI-CA concepts:

+ Company Code Setup
+ Chart of Accounts and GL setup
+ Main / Sub Transaction Setup
+ Security Deposit Process
+ Incoming Payments (Real Time, Direct Debit, Cash Desk, etc.)
+ Outgoing Payments and Returns
+ Collection process using Collection Strategy
+ Collection Agency related process
+ Transfer Posting process
+ Escheatment process

* Strong knowledge of month-end and period-end closing and FICA to FICO GL integration.
* Implementation experience of BRF Plus.
* Experience and knowledge of using middleware technology to integrate SAP with third party systems for payments, collection agencies, etc.
* Experience in data migration.
* Can work under minimum supervision, good time management and work planning

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* College degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.) or comparable job experiences
* Approximately 5 to 8 years of experience in a functional role. Able to exhibit a progression of increasingly complex job responsibilities during the period
* Prior SAP BRIM CI role is a must
* Should have worked on minimum 1 implementation from scratch as a lead consultant.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Experience on integration with third-party applications
* Knowledge of integration with SAP RAR, BRIM CI/SOM/CM
* Hands on experience in SAP S4 HANA Platform
* Experience on tools like JIRA or equivalent tool to maintain stories.
* SAP Utilities certifications are a plus:

+ Certification in SAP FICA (IUT240 / AC240 / BR240)
+ Certifications in SAP BRIM Convergent Invoicing (AC245 / BR245)

**Technologies and Tools**

* SAP FI-CA / FI-CAX
* SAP FIORI
* Jira or similar tools
* Azure DevOps or similar tools

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Utilities practices globally with leading businesses across a range of geographies

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Expert Writer, Medical Content Development
description:
At EVERSANA, we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work across the globe. We’re fueled by our vision to create a healthier world. How? Our global team of more than 7,000 employees is committed to creating and delivering next-generation commercialization services to the life sciences industry. We are grounded in our cultural beliefs and serve more than 650 clients ranging from innovative biotech start-ups to established pharmaceutical companies. Our products, services and solutions help bring innovative therapies to market and support the patients who depend on them. Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us!
  
  
Across our growing organization, we embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We look for team members that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but also who care deeply about EVERSANA, our people, clients and most importantly, the patients we serve. We are EVERSANA.
  
  
**Job Description**
**THE POSITION:**
At EVERSANA, our integrated life sciences compliance team is taking a leading role in helping some of the most scientifically advanced Biopharma and research companies around the world to innovate novel therapies for rare, ultra-rare and a range of critical therapeutic areas including Oncology, Neurology, Immuno-oncology, Immunology etc. This role is within the EVERSANA Compliance team reporting directly to the Manager, Medical Content Development. This person will also collaborate very closely with other team members with in the EVERSANA Compliance Business Unit (Medical Information, Medical Affairs, Pharmacovigilance, Regulatory and Quality).
  
  
The position will support various types of clients including pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, digital therapeutics, and over-the-counter companies. This includes companies of various sizes and, in particular, small and emerging companies. Position is responsible for content development-related client engagements.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by:
  
  

* Plays an essential role supporting Manager, Medical Content Development on content development-related engagements for integrated and complete commercialization deals as well as for clients who require medical information or medical affairs consulting services outside of EVERSANA’s complete commercialization partnerships.
* Writes and creates medical and scientific content related to Medical Affairs, Medical Information and Medical Communications including, but not limited to, Scientific Response Documents (SRD), Frequently Asked Question (FAQ) documents, Slide Sets, Abstracts, Posters, Education and Training materials, and others for potential clients.
* Drives the client document development process from gathering materials and developing scientifically rigorous content to facilitating document review and discussions at medical, legal, regulatory (MLR) review meetings.
* Works with EVERSANA and/or client-provided document management technology platforms (i.e., Veeva PromoMats / MedComms, etc.) as content owner when appropriate, uploading documents, providing reference anchoring and annotations as required.
* May be called up to perform scientific data fact checking for documents in support of medical reviewers participating in MLR teams.
* Collaborates with Manager, Medical Content Development and contributes to discussions on strategy, tactical execution and communication approaches for assigned projects.
* Participates in key client meetings as assigned.
* Supports preparation of thought leadership articles, newsletter, publications, congress presentations, slides, and blogs related to the medical content services and practices.
* Supports creating/updating the SOPs, checklists, templates, style guides, and guidance documents as necessary.
* Mentoring and coaching team members. Support hiring and onboarding as necessary.
* Stays knowledgeable of industry best practices and supports leadership team in evaluating and implementing new technologies and procedures to improve operational efficiency and quality of materials developed.
* Works collaboratively with other medical writers and creative teams across EVERSANA.
* All other duties as assigned

*Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.*
**Expectations Of The Job**

* Responsible to deliver CLIENT DELIGHT
* Responsible to identify, deploy, oversees, mentor direct reports and consultants supporting various clients
* Responsible to work collaboratively with EVERSANA medical information and medical affairs team and take direction and feedback from management and clients
* Responsible to ensure management and compliance with industry standards and codes of practice
* Able to work independently to develop high-quality, scientifically accurate, strategically aligned, ethical, and compliant medical content
* Responsible to proactively flag and manage any quality issues, and ensure timely corrective and preventive actions
* Travel – Up to 10% (only post COVID).
* Hours – Average 40+ hours/week.

**Qualifications**
**MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:**
The requirements listed below are representative of the experience, education, knowledge, skill and/or abilities required.
  
  

* PharmD (or M. Pharm. or M.S. Pharm), PhD, or MD with medical writing and content development experience
* Minimum of 4 years of experience within the life science and/or pharmaceutical industry with extensive medical writing and content development experience
* Direct Medical Information / Medical Communications / Scientific Communications experience
* Exceptional communication skills including, written, oral, interpersonal, and presentation skills including the ability to independently interpret and summarize complex results.
* Ability to effectively interface with all levels of management and staff and to succeed in a matrix team setting while meeting or exceeding timelines.
* Familiarity with AMA Style guide as well as an understanding of clinical research principles and applied statistics. Familiarity with International Committee of Medical Journal Editors (ICMJE), Good Publication Practices (GPP), and other medical publishing guidelines (e.g., Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA), Strengthening the Reporting of Observational Studies in Epidemiology (STROBE), Consolidated Standards of Reporting Trials (CONSORT), etc.
* Proficient editing skills along with expertise in Microsoft Office, Acrobat and other applications.
* Experience conducting literature searches and working with tools such as PubMed, Ovid, Embase, etc.
* Experience working with reference management and citation software (e.g., EndNote, Mendeley, Citavi, etc.)
* Strong understanding of regulatory requirements and best practices in relationship to Medical Information, Medical Affairs and promotional and non-promotional materials review
* Excellent project management skills and proven track record of being results driven; ability to manage
* Ability to conceptualize, design and deliver best in class solutions
* Highly Principled - Proves to be a professional of unquestionable integrity, credibility and character who demonstrates high moral and ethical behavior
* Collaboration – Ability to work cross functionality across EVERSANA business units and with various clients, including leadership and various departments and functions of our clients
* Agile learning – Ability to support and learn about multiple disease states and therapeutic areas.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience developing medical content, especially Medical Information materials, for new product launch
* Experience publishing abstracts, posters, manuscripts
* Experience working across multiple therapeutic areas
* Experience working with Veeva Vault MedComms / Promomats

**Additional Information**
**OUR CULTURAL BELIEFS:**
**Patient Minded**
I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.
  
  
**Client Delight**
I own every client experience and its impact on results.
  
  
**Take Action**
I am empowered and empower others to act now.
  
  
**Grow Talent**
I own my development and invest in the development of others.
  
  
**Win Together**
I passionately connect with anyone, anywhere, anytime to achieve results.
  
  
**Communication Matters**
I speak up to create transparent, thoughtful and timely dialogue.
  
  
**Embrace Diversity**
I create an environment of awareness and respect.
  
  
**Always Innovate**
I am bold and creative in everything I do.
  
  
Our team is aware of recent fraudulent job offers in the market, misrepresenting EVERSANA. Recruitment fraud is a sophisticated scam commonly perpetrated through online services using fake websites, unsolicited e-mails, or even text messages claiming to be a legitimate company. Some of these scams request personal information and even payment for training or job application fees. Please know EVERSANA would never require personal information nor payment of any kind during the employment process. We respect the personal rights of all candidates looking to explore careers at EVERSANA.
  
  
From EVERSANA’s inception, Diversity, Equity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds who share a passion for improving the lives of patients and leading innovation within the healthcare industry. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion, and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees’ points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

description:

FundNexus is an early-stage startup building a platform for the startup and investor ecosystem. We are currently preparing for launch and looking for a motivated Content Writing & Marketing Intern to join our early team.

**Role Overview**

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys writing, researching, understanding startups, and creating meaningful content. You will work closely with the founding team and contribute to FundNexus's website, social media, marketing, and research initiatives.

title: Product Analyst
description:
**About us:**

At PadCare, we’re on a mission to make hygiene sustainable. Founded in 2018, we have developed India’s first patented sanitary napkin recycling technology—PadCareX.

But we’re not just solving a waste problem, we’re building a circular economy that champions environmental resilience and social equity. Our service model closes the loop starting from collection, recycling, and transforming single-use sanitary napkins into sustainable materials, while also creating dignified jobs for marginalized waste workers, especially women, across the country.

With 100+ changemakers across 25+ cities, PadCare is driving real impact—for people and the planet. Recognized by Forbes, the World Economic Forum, and more, we believe business can be a force for good. If you do too, PadCare is where your purpose finds a home.

Oh, and you must have seen us on an episode of Shark Tank India, Season 2 - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7q0cmPtpJRo

To learn more about the work that PadCare is doing, check out the website: www.padcarelabs.com

**Role overview & Key Responsibilities:**

We are hiring a full-time Product Analyst to own modules of our internal Order-to-Cash platform, end to end, working directly with the Product Lead. The core of the role is building requirements: understanding the business process, identifying its gaps, and structuring it into a complete system module that accounts for every case, validation and dependency. You will also test what gets built and make sure the delivered solution matches what was defined.

**Key responsibilities**

1. Requirement building (core)

• Understand business workflows across Sales, Onboarding, Operations and Finance, and identify

process gaps and inefficiencies

• Structure each process into a system module with clear flows and flow charts

• Cover every scenario the module must handle (standard, exception and edge cases) before it

goes to development

• Define fields and data structures, validation rules, dependencies and conditions

• Own and maintain the functional specification for each assigned module

2. Testing and quality assurance

• Write and execute functional test cases for every release

• Run end-to-end workflow testing and user acceptance testing (UAT)

• Log, prioritise and re-test bugs through the periodic bug-fix cycles

3. Development partner coordination

• Work with the external development team on assigned modules

• Track tasks, follow-ups and requirement clarifications

• Ensure the delivered solution matches the defined requirement

4. Data checks for owned modules

• Validate data for the modules you own, including post-go-live accuracy checks

• Work alongside the data management team where module data is involved

**What we're looking for:**

**Must-have**

• 1–3 years in a product, business analyst or functional/QA role on software or ERP projects

• Hands-on experience writing functional specs or BRDs and test cases

• Experience working with development teams through build, testing and release

• Strong analytical and logical thinking; able to structure problems into clear workflows

• Basic understanding of APIs and system design: data flow, validations, logic layers

• Attention to detail and execution focus

• Clear communication across business and tech teams

**Good-to-have**

• Exposure to ERP tools, especially Zoho Books

• Familiarity with Order-to-Cash or billing processes

• Basic SQL

• Exposure to AI or automation use cases (document processing, workflow automation)

Tools you will use

• HTML (basic UI understanding)

• AI tools for productivity and documentation

• Excel and basic analytics tools

**Culture Fit:**
Must align with PadCare’s values – Integrity, Entrepreneurship, Collaboration, Customer-First, Innovation.

**Work Mode:**
Full-time; based in Pune.

**Why join us:**

* **Compensation:**
  Competitive salary in line with industry standards.
* **Growth Path:**
  Opportunity to scale into Head of Research and beyond as PadCare expands globally.
* **Purpose With Impact:**
  Join a mission-driven team transforming menstrual hygiene through sustainable solutions that uplift women’s health, the environment, and sanitation workers' dignity.
* **Eco-Warrior in Action:**
  Help recycle millions of sanitary pads and actively reduce landfill waste and carbon emissions—real impact, not just buzzwords.
* **Innovation Meets Heart:**
  Be part of a team that blends empathy with patented 5D recycling tech to build the future of circular economy.
* **Grow With Us:**
  We’re a fast-gowing, venture-backed startup offering real opportunities to scale your career as we scale our impact.
* **A Culture That Cares:**
  Work in a space where collaboration, inclusivity, and purpose aren’t just values—they’re how we roll every day.

Fusing advanced physics with AI algorithms, our platform, GT-SUITE, is used to simulate a broad range of systems from early-stage development to digital twin applications across multiple industries including transportation and mobility, marine, aerospace and defense, power and energy, data centers and HVACR.

At GT, our people are the driving force behind our success. We are looking for a Senior Application Engineer: Mobility Systems and Integration, who shares our passion for authentic innovation, trusted partnerships, bold decisions and a relentless focus on customer success.

**What You Will Do**

You will join our Applications Team to help our customers get the most out of our solutions and to leverage the knowledge learned from these interactions to continuously improve our software GT-SUITE, a sophisticated desktop software package for simulating almost any kind of engineering multi-physics system. As part of our mobility systems and integration team, you will focus on solutions for vehicle systems and their integration with multiple domains such as drivetrain, thermal management, and controls. The Business Consultant will be part of the Honeywell AutonomyX Center of Excellence (CoE) based in Pune, India, and will play an active role in developing and executing business consulting activities for Middle East, Turkey, and Central Asia (META) region opportunities, with flexibility to engage other regions depending on workload. This role will combine selective front-office ownership of qualified customer opportunities with back-office business development, analysis, proposal, and value-storyline execution in partnership with the Middle East business consulting team.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Business development and selective opportunity leadership for META digital transformation programs for operating companies:

+ Research customer operating models, business priorities, performance improvement levers, and digital/autonomy transformation opportunities
+ Translate customer challenges into structured consulting problem statements linked to Honeywell and AutonomyX solutions
+ Own preparation of executive engagement materials, value hypotheses, customer narratives, and account-specific storylines for selected pursuits
+ Lead or actively participate in selected customer-facing discussions and workshops, including preparation, facilitation, documentation, and follow-up from Pune or on site when required
+ Own customer-ready material including value propositions, executive summaries, business cases, case studies, and sales enablement content for assigned opportunities

* CoE capability building and organizational enablement
* Build and continuously improve repeatable AutonomyX consulting assets, templates, value frameworks, and proposal content within the Pune CoE
* Lead selected internal enablement activities for value-based selling and consulting-led opportunity development across META
* Share best practices, case studies, and reusable methods with regional sales, consulting, and solution teams

**Skills and qualifications**

* Prior consulting experience with a leading consulting firm at Associate level or equivalent, including strategy, operations, transformation, digital, or value-creation work. Alternatively MBA from a leading business school
* Prior experience in Oil & Gas, Chemicals, refining, petrochemicals, or other process industries preferred
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a technical engineering discipline preferred; Chemical Engineering is desirable, although other relevant engineering disciplines will be considered
* Preferred experience in running or contributing to operational transformation programs, performance improvement initiatives, digital transformation programs, or operating model improvement efforts
