title: Sr. Analyst, Implementation
description:
What You'll Do
  
  
**Role Summary — The Why Now**
As Avalara scales its Go Live function to support New Product Introductions (NPI) and enterprise-level customer growth, we need Senior Analysts who do more than execute — they lead, design, and elevate. The Go Live Senior Analyst (I3) operates at the intersection of complex enterprise implementation delivery, cross-functional product collaboration, and practice development.
  
  
Where the I3 Analyst owns individual customer implementation success, the I3 Senior Analyst owns the quality and scalability of how implementations are delivered — for the most complex customers, across new and evolving products, and in close partnership with Product Management, Sales, Engineering, and Customer Success.
  
  
This role exists to accelerate Avalara's ability to onboard enterprise customers at scale, introduce new products effectively, and continuously raise the implementation standard across the Go Live team. The I3 is a force multiplier: their impact is felt not just in their own portfolio, but in the capability and quality of the broader team.
  
  
How This Role Elevates Avalara
  
  

* For customers: Enterprise and multi-product customers receive expert implementation guidance, proactive risk management, and deep technical partnership — resulting in faster time-to-value and stronger long-term adoption.
* For the team: The Senior Analyst sets the implementation quality standard — authoring playbooks, mentoring I3 analysts, and identifying process improvements that raise team-wide performance.
* For the business: Directly supports ARR growth by enabling complex enterprise wins, supporting the sales cycle with pre-sales expertise, and accelerating NPI readiness across implementation teams.
* For our AI-first strategy: Designs and deploys AI-driven implementation workflows at a team level — moving beyond personal productivity to scalable automation that benefits the entire Go Live function.

**What Your Responsibilities Will Be**
**Enterprise & Multi-Product Implementation Leadership**

* Lead customer implementations involving multiple Avalara products and enterprise-level platforms including complex ERP, POS, and ecommerce environments (e.g., NetSuite, Dynamics 365, Salesforce Commerce, SAP).
* Act as the primary implementation authority for high-complexity, high-stakes customer engagements — setting strategy, managing scope, and driving outcomes from kickoff to Go Live.
* Clearly define, articulate, and manage scope of work for client-initiated implementation and data service projects, including change management when scope evolves.

**New Product Introduction (NPI) Enablement**

* Partner with Avalara Product Management, Sales, and Customer Success teams to develop implementation approach documentation, onboarding frameworks, and training materials for new product launches.
* Serve as a subject matter expert during NPI cycles — identifying implementation risks, documenting configuration requirements, and ensuring Go Live readiness before product release.
* Identify bugs, integration gaps, or UX friction during NPI implementations and partner with Engineering to track and resolve them.

**Practice Development & Quality Elevation**

* Own and evolve Go Live practice standards — documenting business processes, designing implementation playbooks, and proposing best practices for sales and use tax automation onboarding.
* Develop and document business requirements related to implementation workflows, data transformation, and cross-system reporting.
* Lead testing plan design and execution for complex implementations, ensuring customers go live on validated, stable configurations.
* Mentor and provide structured guidance to I2 Analysts — reviewing implementation quality, sharing expertise, and accelerating the development of junior team members.

**Cross-Functional Stakeholder Partnership**

* Collaborate with Sales and Account Management to support pre-sales activities — including scoping, solution design input, and customer-facing technical presentations.
* Engage cross-functionally across Product, Engineering, Support, and Finance to resolve systemic implementation blockers and drive process improvements at scale.
* Represent the Go Live team's perspective in strategic planning discussions, NPI readiness reviews, and cross-departmental initiatives.

**Customer Success & Risk Management**

* Monitor project health across assigned accounts — proactively identifying risk factors, intervening early, and resolving escalations with speed and precision.
* Provide strategic guidance to customers on best practices and use cases across a range of business models and tax compliance needs.
* Support customers in developing and executing testing plans, ensuring technical readiness before Go Live.

**AI-Driven Practice Scaling**

* Design and deploy AI-powered workflows at a team level — building reusable Glean AI agents, prompt libraries, and automation tools that improve implementation quality and speed across the Go Live function.
* Share AI innovations, document their impact, and drive adoption across I2 and I3 peers.

**12-Month Success Signals**
A successful Go Live Senior Analyst (I3) at the end of 12 months will have:
  
  

* Led multiple enterprise or multi-product implementations to successful Go Live with measurably shorter cycle times and low escalation rates, demonstrating ownership at a higher complexity tier than I2.
* Delivered at least two NPI readiness contributions — documented implementation playbooks, training materials, or bug reports — that were formally adopted by the Go Live or Product teams.
* Authored or significantly improved at least two Go Live practice standards or playbooks, with measurable adoption and quality impact across the team.
* Mentored at least two I2 Analysts with demonstrable improvement in their implementation quality metrics or time-to-competency.
* Built and deployed at least one AI-powered workflow (e.g., a Glean agent, automation script, or prompt framework) that generated measurable time savings or quality improvements at a team level — not just personally.
* Supported at least one pre-sales engagement in partnership with the Sales or Account Management team, contributing to a customer expansion or new business outcome.

AI Expectations
  
  
Avalara is an AI-first company. The Go Live Senior Analyst (I3) is expected to operate as an AI Bar Raiser — not just embedding AI into their own work, but actively raising AI capability across the Go Live team.
  
  
**Specific Expectations Include**

* Design and build reusable AI tools — including Glean AI agents, automated documentation workflows, and AI-assisted risk detection models — that are shared and adopted across the team.
* Use AI to analyze implementation portfolio data at scale, identifying patterns in at-risk implementations, NPI friction points, or recurring ERP configuration issues, and translating insights into proactive action.
* Deploy AI to accelerate NPI documentation, training material generation, and business requirements capture — dramatically compressing the time from product release to team readiness.
* Use AI to support customer communication at scale — generating implementation status summaries, tailored onboarding guidance, and escalation documentation with speed and precision.
* Coach I2 Analysts on applied AI usage, sharing effective practices and helping peers move from casual familiarity to embedded, outcome-driven AI workflows.
* Apply AI responsibly and securely, in full compliance with Avalara's data governance and AI ethics policies.

Candidates must demonstrate specific, quantified examples of AI usage that improved team-level outcomes — not just personal efficiency. Senior Analysts who cannot clearly articulate their AI impact across a team or function do not meet Avalara's AI Bar Raiser standard for this level.

title: Data Specialist -PCB Manufacturing (Valor)
description:
**Creating passion: your responsibilities**
**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Preparation, validation, and optimization of PCB manufacturing data for SMT production.
* Create, maintain, and optimize machine programs for Pick & Place, AOI, SPI, and related manufacturing equipment.
* Manage and validate manufacturing data packages including Gerber, ODB++, IPC-2581, Bill of Materials (BOM), and Component Placement List (CPL).
* Analyze PCB design data and ensure Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA) compliance.
* Coordinate with PCB Design, Production Engineering, Quality, and Manufacturing teams for seamless product realization.
* Support New Product Introduction (NPI) activities, prototype builds, and product industrialization processes.
* Troubleshoot and resolve manufacturing, programming, and assembly-related issues to improve production efficiency.
* Develop and maintain manufacturing engineering databases, libraries, and machine setup documentation.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives related to production planning, manufacturing data quality, process optimization, and automation workflows.
* Maintain and enhance manufacturing engineering tools such as Siemens Valor and other MES/CAM-related applications.
* Support capacity planning, production scheduling, and process standardization activities.
* Ensure compliance with company quality standards, IPC requirements, and manufacturing best practices.

**HeadlineContributing your strengths: your qualifications**
**Technical Skills**

* Hands-on experience with Siemens Valor Process Preparation, Valor NPI, or similar PCB manufacturing engineering tools.
* Strong understanding of SMT manufacturing processes including solder paste printing, SPI, Pick & Place, reflow soldering, and AOI inspection.
* Knowledge of PCB manufacturing data formats such as Gerber, ODB++, IPC-2581, BOM, Centroid/CPL, and fabrication drawings.
* Experience in creating and optimizing machine programs for SMT equipment.
* Working knowledge of PCB design tools such as Xpedition, Altium Designer, PADS, OrCAD, or KiCad.
* Ability to perform Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA) reviews.
* Familiarity with CAM tools such as CAM350, Valor, GerbTool, or equivalent platforms.
* Knowledge of IPC standards including IPC-A-610, IPC-7351, IPC-2221, IPC-2581, and IPC-6012.
* Experience with ERP/PLM systems such as SAP, Windchill, or Enovia will be an added advantage.
* Understanding of manufacturing process documentation, work instructions, and engineering change management.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work independently while coordinating with global and cross-functional teams.
* Good organizational and documentation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and meet production timelines.
* Proactive, detail-oriented, and continuous improvement mindset.

Qualification and Education Requirements:
  
Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (Electronics, Electronics & Telecommunication, Electrical, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline).
  
  
**Experience:**

* 5-8 years of experience in PCB Manufacturing Industry, SMT Production Planning, PCB Data Preparation, or related functions.
* Hands-on experience with Siemens Valor and SMT programming environments preferred.
* Experience in electronics manufacturing, EMS, or PCB assembly industry will be an added advantage.

Peferred Skills / Special Skills:
  

* Exposure to NPI, DFM/DFA, and industrialization activities.
* Understanding of SMT line balancing and production planning concepts.
* Knowledge of automation workflows and manufacturing process optimization.

More than 250 manufacturers rely on our ICyte Platform to orchestrate their commercial and government payer contracting, patient services, and distribution channels. ICyte is the first and only platform that unites the financial, operational, and commercial data sets required to support therapy access in the era of specialty and precision medicine. With ICyte, Life Sciences innovators can digitalize their market access operations, freeing up resources to focus on more data-driven decision support. With ICyte, Life Sciences innovators are digitalizing labor-intensive processes – freeing up their best talent to identify and resolve coverage and availability hurdles and to manage pricing and forecasting complexity.
  
  
We are headquartered in Philadelphia, PA (USA), with offices in: Ambler, PA (USA); Pune, India; and Medellín, Colombia. For more information, visit www.integrichain.com, or follow us on Twitter @IntegriChain and LinkedIn.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Your mission at IntegriChain:**
The mission of the Business Architect is to develop and deliver insightful, value-added strategies and solutions that address our clients' most complex challenges. You will lead functional workstreams on client engagements, guiding teams from problem definition through solution delivery. Beyond the engagement work, you will mentor colleagues, share your subject-matter expertise, and build the organizational capabilities that allow us to deliver world-class solutions for our clients.
  
  
The ideal candidate will provide leadership for Government Pricing and Medicaid on the ICyte Platform, especially for large, enterprise pharmaceutical clients. You'll own the end-to-end GP configuration, set the standards implementation partners deliver against, and serve as a trusted advisor to clients.
  
  
**What you’ll do to thrive in this role:**

* Manage the Government Pricing and Medicaid workstreams for a large, complex Pharma manufacturer with minimal supervision
* Guide client in effectively using the ICyte system
* Gather client enhancement requirements to share with IntegriChain’s Product Engineering team for future development
* Liaise between clients and IntegriChain's Product Engineering group to assess software quarterly release impact on the client
* Works closely with client IT and business teams to develop quarterly testing plans, develop test data, and assist client in quarterly test activities
* Build and maintain GP training materials, configuration guides, and best practices, and lead knowledge transfer across internal teams
* Support project plans, status reports, and other project documentation, and oversee development of engagement deliverables
* Use domain expertise and data-driven reasoning to provide functional thought leadership internally and to clients

**Qualifications**
**What you’ll bring to the table:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, technology or related fields and/or equivalent experience. Master’s degree, Finance or Pharmaceutical Management MBA, preferred
* Demonstrated, hands-on experience in pharmaceutical Government Pricing and Medicaid, including calculation methodologies and regulatory reporting
* Experience supporting large or enterprise pharmaceutical manufacturers in the following areas: Government Contracting and Pricing, AMP, ASP, BP, NFAMP, PHS/340b, etc., Commercial Contracting
* Experience with Model N Flex, Model N Powered by N, or comparable GP systems, strongly preferred
* Ability to learn a new platform quickly and teach it to others, with strong documentation and training skills
* Experience working with and evaluating large transaction data sets.

Additional Information

* Mission driven: Work with the purpose of helping to improve patients' lives!
* Excellent and affordable medical benefits + non-medical perks including Flexible Paid Time Off and much more!
* Robust Learning & Development opportunities including over 700+ development courses free to all employees

IntegriChain is committed to equal treatment and opportunity in all aspects of recruitment, selection, and employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ethnicity, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other category protected under the law. title: Digital Execution Specialist II
description:
* We deliver the world’s most complex projects.
* Work as part of a collaborative and inclusive team.
* Enjoy a varied & challenging role.

**Building on our past. Ready for the future**
Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia.
  
  
Right now, we’re bridging two worlds as we accelerate to more sustainable energy sources, while helping our customers provide the energy, chemicals and resources that society needs now.
  
  
We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their portfolio of assets. We solve complex problems by finding integrated data-centric solutions from the first stages of consulting and engineering to installation and commissioning, to the last stages of decommissioning and remediation. Join us and help drive innovation and sustainability in our projects.
  
  
**The Role**
***As a***
***Digital Execution Specialist II***
***with Worley,***
you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.
  
  
The Project Information & Data Coordinator will be responsible for managing, governing, and assuring the quality of all engineering and project data across systems and disciplines. Role will be responsible to ensures that project data is accurate, consistent, structured, and compliant with client and organizational requirements throughout the project lifecycle. On large or complex projects, the Project Information & Data Coordinator will report to Project Information Manager and acts as the focal point for all data-related activities across engineering, procurement, construction, and handover phases.
  
  
**Data Management & Governance**

* Ensure availability, integrity, consistency, completeness, and reliability of project data across all systems.
* Maintain structured data repositories (Project Data Warehouse / digital tools).
* Enforce project and client data standards, specifications, and governance frameworks.

**Engineering Data Management**

* Manage engineering data across disciplines ensuring alignment with project requirements.
* Ensure data uniqueness, traceability, and lifecycle value of asset data.
* Support data-centric execution approach across engineering workflows.

**Class Library & Standards Management**

* Create and Manage class libraries (e.g., equipment classes, attributes, UOMs) using standard tools.
* Ensure correct classification and standardization of asset data.

**Data Integration & Interface Management**

* Manage data exchange between systems as per Data Exchange Agreements (DEA).
* Coordinate interfaces between project tools, client systems, and third-party platforms.

**Data Quality Assurance**

* Monitor and control data quality through validation, audits, and reporting.
* Identify and coordinate to resolve data inconsistencies across systems and disciplines.

**Supplier & Vendor Data Management**

* Define and manage supplier data requirements and ensure compliance.
* Coordinate data submission, validation, and integration from vendors.

**Reporting & Analytics**

* Generate dashboards and reports to support project tracking and decision-making.
* Provide data quality and completeness reports to project stakeholders.

**Data Handover & Archiving**

* Ensure structured, validated, and timely data handover to the client.
* Manage data archiving and close-out activities.

**Team Coordination**

* Shall report to Project Information Manager (PIM) on a project and provide required support to PIM for the final data delivery to the client.
* Coordinate with discipline leads to ensure compliance with data requirements.
* Provide training and awareness on data management processes.

**About You**
To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:
  
  
**Key Skills & Competencies**

* Strong understanding of engineering data lifecycle and EPC workflows.
* Knowledge of data governance, class libraries, and data standards. Experience with Class library development tool.
* Experience with project digital tools (EDMS, data warehouses, integration tools, SmartPlant and AVEVA suites, etc.).
* Strong analytical and data quality management skills, Experience with Power BI Dashboard.
* Experience with SharePoint setup and management.
* Ability to coordinate across multidisciplinary teams.
* Good communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Problem-solving and attention to detail.

**Experience & Qualifications**

* Engineering degree or relevant technical qualification with minimum 10 years’ experience in relevant role.
* Experience in engineering data management / information management roles in large EPC or digital execution projects.
* Expertise with data integration, digital execution, and handover requirements handling.
* Experience in Class Library setup and management tool (Aveva ISM).
* Preferred to have previous working knowledge on Information management tools like Aveva AIM, SmartPlant or Aveva - 2D, 3D Engineering design tools, Aveva Engineering.
* Good to have knowledge on document Management tools, Procurement tools, Advance Work Packaging tools for Construction and Commissioning management tools.
* Added advantage of having working knowledge on Agile scrum methodology, knowledge on SharePoint Data warehouse Setup and management, Power automate, Power BI and analytics tools.

**Moving forward together**
We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation.
  
  
We’re building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.
  
  
And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology.
  
  
Whatever your ambition, there’s a path for you here. And there’s no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.
  
  
Worley takes personal data protection seriously and respects EU and local data protection laws. You can read our full Recruitment Privacy Notice Here.
  
  
Please note: If you are being represented by a recruitment agency you will not be considered, to be considered you will need to apply directly to Worley.

description:

As a Technical Account Manager (TAM), you will work closely with our customers, build relationships with them, help them achieve their technical goals, and overcome technical challenges.The Technical Account Manager (TAM) serves as a trusted technical partner to customers, acting as the primary point of contact for technical guidance, system optimization, and issue coordination after implementation. The TAM works closely with customer System Administrators and internal teams to understand business processes, ensure effective system configuration, and help customers maximize value from the platform.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Named Technical Contact**

* Serve as the dedicated technical resource for assigned customer accounts
* Partner with customer System Administrators to understand business processes, workflows, and system configurations
* Maintain deep familiarity with each customer’s environment, priorities, and use cases55

**Product Expertise & Consultation**

* Act as a product expert, providing guidance, best practices, and technical consultation
* Translate customer business needs into system configuration and optimization recommendations
* Support customers in understanding platform capabilities, limitations, and tradeoffs

**Issue Facilitation & Support Oversight**

* Provide oversight and coordination for customer support tickets
* Own or directly manage highly technical or complex issues as needed
* Effectively escalate critical and urgent issues, partnering with Support, Engineering, and Product teams to drive resolution
* Analyze support trends and proactively address recurring issues

**Readiness & Enablement Management**

* Ensure customers are prepared for and leveraging new product features
* Conduct Release Readiness Reviews to prepare customers for upcoming releases, including testing, configuration changes, and process impacts
* Partner with customers to drive feature adoption aligned to their business goals

**Trusted Advisor & Relationship Management**

* Run a regular cadence of customer meetings to review:

+ Open workstreams and initiatives
+ Support ticket status and analysis
+ New questions and technical needs
+ Open and prioritized issues
+ Action items and next steps

* Serve as a trusted consultant, ensuring alignment between customer goals and platform usage
* Advocate for customer needs internally and provide feedback to Product and Engineering teams

* always strive to provide exceptional customer experience

* build positive relationships with peers while working remotely with others across geographies and cultures

title: Product Design / Product Engineer/ Specialist
description:
****Job Summary:****
This product focused position performs established technical tasks at the sub-system and/or component level for current and future products within a given business unit or corporate area. This involves work across many steps in the product life cycle. Because of the product centered nature of this position, they are very often a central point of coordination and decision making between product line engineers, customer teams, systems engineers, purchasing, suppliers and manufacturing.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities:****
Obtains input from stakeholders such as technical managers, project leaders, other product and manufacturing engineers and supplier partners to deliver information and recommendations that lead to quality product decisions. Applies academic knowledge and existing experience to take action and make decisions that progress projects forward without sacrificing project quality expectations. Examples of these decisions include day to day project details, analysis or test work instruction details, coordination across discipline areas that are necessary to make quality progress. Applies and improves processes such as Engineering Standard Work (ESW), iDFMEA, Failure Incident Review Group (FIRG) and tools such as 7-step problem solving, design review checklist and other specialized tools required to support the processes and enable high quality decision making. Provides independent leadership of smaller business impact projects or ownership of complex components, products, systems or services with greater elements of ambiguity over the senior or lead engineer level and with full accountability to the project team. Delivers independent execution of established and emerging work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge. Leads the development and improvement of work processes and systems across a functional discipline area within a business unit site. Coordinates and directs work amongst technicians and temporary student employees, assists in the transfer of knowledge to lesser experienced engineers through either indirect (scope of influence) or direct management of a small, local group of engineers. Provides support and guidance to influence technical direction within a project team and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role. Operates as a recognized specialist in a discipline or product area within the immediate team.
  
  
****Competencies:****
Product Development Execution, Monitoring and Control - Plans, schedules, coordinates and executes the activities involved in developing a product to a respectively aligned hierarchy of requirements and technical profiles; monitors and communicates across functional boundaries to meet project resource and quality expectations; ensures product capability meets or exceeds expectations and takes mitigating actions when project risks are higher than expected; understands the full product life cycle process and stakeholders.
  
  
Product Failure Mode Avoidance - Mitigates potential product failure modes, by identifying interfaces, functions, functional requirements, interactions, control factors, noise factors, and prioritized potential failure modes and potential failure causes for the system of interest to effectively and efficiently improve the reliability of Cummins’ products.
  
  
Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis - Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub-system and/or component level requirements.
  
  
Product Interface Management and Integration - Identifies and analyzes the interfaces and interactions across system boundaries by specifying the requirements and limits to ensure that the product meets requirements; controls the interactions across the system element boundaries by making sure that they remain within specified limits; integrates system elements by creating an integration plan, including identification of method and timing for each activity to make it easier to find, isolate, diagnose, and correct.
  
  
Product Problem Solving - Solves product problems using a process that protects the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; and identifies the systemic root causes and recommended actions to prevent problem reoccurrence.
  
  
Product Verification and Validation Management - Develops product systems validation plans from a variety of inputs to identify failure modes, while managing product risk and relative priority; negotiates product requirements against capability to guide project scope; evaluates analytical, simulation and physical test results to verify product capability and validate requirements; assesses legacy versus proposed system solution capabilities and produces recommendations with technical documentation to support product decisions.
  
  
System Requirements Engineering - Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.
  
  
Technical Documentation - Documents information based on knowledge gained as part of technical function activities; communicates to stakeholders with the goal of enabling improved technical productivity and effective knowledge transfer to others who were not originally part of the initial learning.
  
  
Technical Documentation - Documents information based on knowledge gained as part of technical function activities; communicates to stakeholders with the goal of enabling improved technical productivity and effective knowledge transfer to others who were not originally part of the initial learning.
  
  
Builds networks - Effectively building formal and informal relationship networks inside and outside the organization.
  
  
Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
  
  
Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.
  
  
Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
  
  
Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
  
  
Resourcefulness - Securing and deploying resources effectively and efficiently.
  
  
Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
  
  
Design and Application of Open/Closed Loop Controls - Specifies software features that interact with mechanical, hydraulic, chemical and electronic systems to deliver desired system states; specifies control system architectures which include appropriate measurements, correct actuation, and algorithms for Cummins' products; configures and/or understands open/closed loop feedback controls features and the system interactions between hardware and software in Cummins' products.
  
  
Product Configuration and Change Management - Establishes a baseline of identified product artifacts to be placed under configuration management; releases, tracks, controls and communicates changes from concept to obsolescence often through work requests; establishes and maintains the integrity of the product artifact baselines.
  
  
Mechanical Design of Mechanical Systems - Acquires and applies an in-depth understanding of mechanical systems through working knowledge that guides a designer’s ability to create innovative and sound design concepts to meet Cummins and customer expectations; designs for requirements of all lifecycle stages by considering the customer requirements in different operating environments to ensure a robust system.
  
  
Mechanical Design Specification - Creates complete specifications in the form of solid models, configured engineering bill of materials and detailed drawings that cross-functionally communicate the information required to manufacture and inspect a product per its design intent; considers national, international, industry, and Cummins’ standards that accurately and concisely define the part specification.
  
  
****Education, Licenses, Certifications:****
College, university, or equivalent Bachelor's degree in Engineering or appropriate STEM field is required.
  
  
Post-graduate (Master's) degree relevant to this discipline area may be required for select roles.
  
  
This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.
  
  
****Experience:****
Prior Senior or Lead Engineer equivalent work experience in a relevant discipline area is required with a demonstrated track record of technical problem solving and quality decision making. Knowledge of MS Office tools is preferred.
  
  
****Skills:****

* Strong understanding of ADS components like Doser, Mixers and/or fuel systems components.
* Proficiency in 3D modeling tools (Creo) and engineering drawing standards (GD&T).
* Knowledge of design tools and methodologies (DFMEA, DFM, DFA, DV&V).
* Familiarity with Cummins processes (VPI, PPT, CPS) and tools (Windchill, RV&S).
* Ability to interpret simulation results (structural and flow analysis).
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Effective communication and collaboration abilities.
* Working knowledge of manufacturing processes and product validation techniques.

****Experience:****

* 5+ years of experience in CES products or Fuel Systems product lines
* 6–8 years of product design and development experience preferred.
* Experience in cross-functional design reviews and product lifecycle processes.
* Familiarity with MS Office tools is preferred.

title: Associate or Senior Editor (Climate and Earth science), Nature Portfolio
description:
**Associate or Senior Editor (Climate and Earth science), Research Cross-Journal Editorial Team, Nature Portfolio**
**Locations:**
Pune, New Delhi, Beijing, Shanghai - Hybrid Model
  
  
**Application Deadline: November 3**
**About Springer Nature**
Springer Nature is one of the leading publishers of research in the world. We publish the largest number of journals and books and are a pioneer in open research. Through our leading brands, trusted for more than 180 years, we provide technology-enabled products, platforms and services that help researchers to uncover new ideas and share their discoveries, health professionals to stay at the forefront of medical science, and educators to advance learning. We are proud to be part of progress, working together with the communities we serve to share knowledge and bring greater understanding to the world. For more information, please visit about.springernature.com and @SpringerNature.
  
  
**About The Brand**
Nature Portfolio is a flagship portfolio of journals, products and services including Nature and the Nature-branded journals, dedicated to serving the scientific community. Visit Nature.com and follow @Nature / @NaturePortolfio.
  
  
Nature Portfolio is a world leader in publishing high-quality research. The Nature Portfolio journals include
*Nature*
, the Nature Research journals, the Nature Reviews journals,
*Nature Communications*
as well as the Communications journals and NPJ series.
  
  
**About The Role**
Springer Nature is seeking an Associate or Senior Editor to join the Research Cross-Journal Editorial Team.
  
  
This exciting position involves being part of a team of editors that will work closely — and flexibly — with the existing Nature Research Journals, such as
*Nature Climate Change, Nature Geoscience, Nature Sustainability,*
*Nature Water*
. The ideal candidate would be a critical thinker with a deep understanding of their subject, curiosity and a desire to learn about areas beyond it, and who can think on their feet.
  
  
**Role responsibilities:**

* Supporting editorial processes relating to manuscript assessment and the peer-review process.
* Commissioning, editing and writing content for journals.
* Working closely with Chief Editors and journal teams, while reporting to the Head of the Research Cross-Journal Team, on other aspects of journal content and strategy, as appropriate.

**Experience, Skills & Qualifications:**

* Research experience to PhD level (or equivalent) in Earth and/or climate science. Expertise relating to biogeochemistry, land surface interactions and feedbacks, agriculture, and forestry are especially welcome.
* A keen interest in research both within and beyond your specialty.
* The ability to absorb and understand new areas of research.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
* Time management and work prioritization skills.
* Postdoctoral experience is not required but would be a plus.
* Previous editorial experience is desirable but not essential.
* Additional expertise in related disciplines would be advantageous.

**Applicants must include**
**to be considered**

* A brief cover letter explaining your interest in the role, relevant experience, preferred office location, salary expectations and current notice period.
* A CV detailing your education, employment history, list of published scientific papers, and any achievements demonstrating your suitability for the position.
* A selection of three papers published this year or last year that were not published in Nature or Science journals, which you would consider for publication in Nature Climate Change. Please provide a full reference and link to each article, together with a rationale of no more than five sentences for each choice.

**Closing Date: November 3**
*For Milan, Italy positions only:*

* Associate Editor: Minimum salary €41,500
* Senior Editor: Minimum salary €55,000

*National Collective Labour Agreement for employees of printing, publishing, digital and related companies (Publishers’ Section) – CNEL Code G011*
Springer Nature promotes an inclusive work environment and welcomes applications from individuals belonging to protected categories under Italian Law 68/99.
  
  
At Springer Nature, our mission is to be part of progress – and that begins with inclusion: of people, perspectives, and ideas. We believe that diverse perspectives drive progress, and we are committed to creating an environment where people and ideas can flourish. If you have any access needs related to disability, neurodivergence or a chronic condition, please contact us so we can make all necessary accommodation. Find out more about our DEI work here https://group.springernature.com/gp/group/taking-responsibility/diversity-equity-inclusion

So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.
  
  
**About The Team**
At Workday, we bring technical rigor, customer empathy, and a spirit of fun to enterprise software. Our support team underpins operational excellence across Workday's digital experience, AI/ML platform, and Agent Factory initiative—our internal engine that builds, trains, and deploys autonomous AI agents to execute complex HR and Finance workflows.
  
  
Within this broader ecosystem, the Workday Adaptive Planning Support team plays a critical role in empowering our customers to build agile, data-driven financial strategies. We partner directly with core engineering, data science, and product development to eliminate bottlenecks, maintain high platform availability, and ensure system reliability across both traditional SaaS features and next-generation AI workflows for our global customer base.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a customer-focused
**Support Engineer**
who is excited about supporting AI/ML/ SaaS functionality and platforms and passionate about helping customers solve complex problems. In this
**high-visibility, customer-facing role**
, you will manage a ticket queue of cases with varying complexity specifically for Adaptive Planning’s Financial and Workforce Planning products.
  
  
You will drive incident resolution, root-cause analysis (RCA), and performance optimization across both Workday Adaptive Planning’s enterprise web applications and autonomous AI agent workflows. Partnering closely with product and support analyst teams, you will help customers find timely workarounds and solutions while managing critical escalations within strict SLAs.
  
  
A key part of this role will also involve hands-on technical debugging and AI evaluation. You will analyze system metrics, debug cloud-hosted ML service pipelines, inspect LLM orchestration layers, review conversation logs, and dig into system traces to spot failure modes—translating those insights into prompt, data, and workflow improvements.
  
  
**Location & Shift**

* Location: This position is based in the Workday Pune office. Candidates should be local to the Pune area or willing to relocate.
* Hybrid Work: Candidates will be expected to work from the office at least 50% of the time.
* Hours: Typical shift will be from 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM IST
* On-Call: Participation in an on-call rotation is required to provide after-hours support when needed.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Core Planning and Reporting Troubleshooting: Troubleshoot with customers on cases to resolve reported issues with their financial data, reporting, and/or financial integrations.
* Enterprise SaaS & Functional Domain Expertise: Apply foundational knowledge of enterprise applications to validate AI responses and assist in troubleshooting functional processing errors.
* Hands-On AI Evaluation: Review LLM outputs, conversation logs, and execution traces to identify edge cases, hallucinations, and routine failure modes. Perform structured data labeling and report findings to senior engineering staff.
* Technical Troubleshooting & RCA: Assist in root-cause analysis for software defects and pipeline execution failures using monitoring tools like Kibana and Grafana, following established diagnostic runbooks.
* Cloud & LLM Diagnostics: Inspect enterprise AI workflows hosted in public cloud environments (AWS, GCP), helping isolate breakdown points across model hosting services and API gateways.
* Incident & Queue Management: Monitor and triage support queues, enforce SLAs, and process incoming tickets efficiently. Support high-severity incident responses and participate in weekend on-call rotations.
* Customer Communication: Communicate clear technical updates, standard workarounds, and resolution steps to customer IT teams, working with senior support for high-stakes escalations.
* Database & Code Diagnostics: Write standard SQL queries to validate backend data integrity, inspect REST/SOAP API payloads (JSON/XML), and execute existing Python or Bash scripts to run routine diagnostics.
* Documentation & Team Collaboration: Maintain detailed investigation logs in Jira, ServiceNow, or Salesforce, help maintain team runbooks, and flag recurring issue trends to senior engineers and product teams.

**About You**
**Basic Qualifications (Required)**

* Work Experience: Minimum 1 year of experience in technical support, platform operations, or application support for enterprise SaaS environments.
* Technical & Diagnostic Skills:

+ Minimum 1 year of experience writing and executing intermediate SQL queries and running diagnostic scripts.
+ Minimum 1 year of experience inspecting API payloads (JSON or XML data structures) and utilizing basic Linux or Windows command-line tools.

* Cloud & Monitoring Systems:

+ Minimum 1 year of hands-on experience navigating or monitoring services on public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
+ Minimum 1 year of experience utilizing observability tools (e.g., Grafana, Kibana, Datadog) to view logs or trace outputs.

* AI & LLM Exposure: Minimum 1 year of experience inspecting, reading, or evaluating AI/LLM conversation logs, traces, or prompt outputs.
* Triage & Operations:

+ Minimum 1 year of experience performing initial queue triage and basic troubleshooting using ticketing workflows.
+ Ability to manage multiple cases at once with some to no guidance around prioritization.
+ Willingness and ability to work scheduled weekend and holiday coverage rotations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical work experience).
* Experience following established runbooks to perform guided, autonomous technical troubleshooting.
* History of drafting clear written technical documentation, post-incident updates, or resolution notes for customer-facing teams.
* Strong active problem-solving skills and an adaptability to learn complex, multi-tiered enterprise systems.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, combined with the ability to communicate with users at all levels and varying technical ability.
* Experience collaborating with internal development and/or QA teams, acting as a customer advocate.
* Had previous experience or knowledge of finance and/or financial planning software applications or integrations
* Have these technical skills:

+ ETL, tools (e.g., Pentaho) or Integration Implementation/Support
+ Jenkins & Git
+ Kubernetes and Docker
+ ELK or other log aggregation tool
+ JavaScript

On request, a Functional Engineer can be asked to be involved in solving urgent high priority incidents and plays a role in process improvements alongside with business.
  
  
Depending on the domain and the progress of IT Fusion in our organization, the work is either done in agile teams under the leadership of a Scrum Master or in the case of a waterfall under the leadership of the Project Manager. Depending on the seniority of the Engineer, he/she will also assume these project management activities as a role or will take lead in delivery of end-to-end changes.

Translate business requirements into clear detailed designs. Own and develop high quality Stories (change specifications) and project changes for Engineers and External Consultants to then translate into code or config and a proposal on a change implementation.
  
  
**Development & delivery**

**Testing**
Own testing of changes or stories, and/or actively oversee testing by business. Develop test scripts, examine test outcomes, sign off for unit testing and coordinate business sign off for Application Delivery related testing. Contribute to test planning and test management for a specific release.
  
  
Resulting in, changes and/or code are properly and timely tested.
  
  
**Incident management**
Perform functional or technical problem analysis in case of incidents or issues as needed depending on the severity of the problem. Perform root cause analysis, document these and share findings. Deploy (or oversee deployment) of updates and fixes. To ensure that issues, incidents and problems are swiftly and effectively resolved.

Monitor, guard, test and analyze that the use and security of applications and systems regarding the functional and performance aspects are in line with the agreed performance indicators, and if necessary, take measures. Actively contribute to process improvement: e.g. tool development, dashboard/insight development and visualization, script automation. Resulting in, available and optimally performing applications and IT infrastructure for the business and, DevOps process, tooling and dashboards are continuously improving.
  
  
**Project support**

**Experience**

title: Engineer - V&V
description: What You’ll DoEaton announced, on June 11, 20206, the intent to combine its Mobility Group (including both the Vehicle and eMobility segments) with a new company. We expect to complete this process by the end of the first half of 2027. The compensation and benefits that will initially be offered for this position are based on Eaton's plans, programs and practices. If you are offered and accept this position and are actively employed by the Mobility Group when the transaction closes, the new company will provide further details to employees concerning compensation and benefits at that time.This position is part of the Vehicle Controls Product Line engineering team and supports verification and validation of rugged operator-control products for on-road and off-road vehicles and commercial mobile equipment. Products include rocker, toggle, push-button, key-lock, and rotary switches; indicators; multiplexed keypads and electronic switch modules; operator-control and human-machine interface products; and vehicle input/output modules. The engineer will translate customer, system, electronics, mechanical, software, environmental, reliability, safety, and regulatory requirements into traceable verification plans, test procedures, test setups, and objective evidence. The role supports the full product-development cycle—from requirements review and design-risk assessment through prototype evaluation, design verification, product validation, production launch, and lifecycle support—and may also support electronics hardware design, schematic review, component selection, circuit calculations, printed circuit board design reviews, bring-up, and debugging under guidance from senior engineers."What you’ll do: Review customer, system, hardware, software, mechanical, safety, environmental, reliability, and regulatory requirements and convert them into clear, measurable verification criteria. Develop and maintain requirements traceability, Design Verification Plans and Reports, test plans, test cases, procedures, acceptance criteria, schedules, and compliance evidence for Vehicle Controls products. Verify and validate rocker, toggle, push-button, key-lock, and rotary switches; indicators; multiplexed keypads and electronic switch modules; operator-control and human-machine interface products; and vehicle input/output modules. Plan and execute functional, electrical, electronic, mechanical, environmental, electromagnetic compatibility, ingress-protection, vibration, shock, thermal, durability, operating-force and travel, tactile-response, communication, and fault-insertion testing, as applicable. Design, assemble, commission, and troubleshoot test fixtures, wiring harnesses, loads, instrumentation, data-acquisition systems, and automated or semi-automated test setups. Select suitable internal and external laboratories, coordinate test readiness and sample availability, witness testing when required, and drive accurate, on-time completion of planned activities. Analyze test data, determine pass/fail status, document observations and conclusions, and communicate coverage, progress, risks, and results to project stakeholders. Investigate failures using structured problem-solving methods; reproduce issues, isolate root causes, support corrective actions, and verify their effectiveness. Participate in design reviews, requirements reviews, design failure mode and effects analysis, test-readiness reviews, and product-release reviews; provide testability, robustness, and risk-reduction recommendations. Support electronics hardware design activities, including schematic and bill-of-material reviews, component selection and derating, circuit calculations and simulation, printed circuit board layout reviews, prototype bring-up, bench debugging, and design documentation.QualificationsBachelor’s degree in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechatronics, Automotive Engineering, or a related discipline; a master’s degree is preferred.0–2 years of relevant experience with a master’s degree, or 2–4 years with a bachelor’s degree, in product verification and validation, electronics testing, or electronics hardware design. Automotive, off-highway, or vehicle-control product experience is preferred.Skills" Experience or academic exposure relevant to rugged Vehicle Controls products such as switches, indicators, multiplexed keypads, electronic switch modules, human-machine interfaces, and vehicle input/output modules. Working knowledge of verification and validation planning, requirements traceability, test-case development, acceptance criteria, test execution, defect reporting, and technical report preparation. Understanding of analog and digital electronics, microcontroller-based circuits, power supplies, communication interfaces, sensors, actuators, protection circuits, and electronic components. Ability to read and review electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, printed circuit board layouts, bills of material, component data sheets, mechanical drawings, and interface-control documents. Hands-on familiarity with oscilloscopes, digital multimeters, power supplies, electronic loads, signal generators, data-acquisition systems, environmental chambers, and automated test tools. Ability to develop and troubleshoot test fixtures, wiring harnesses, loads, instrumentation, and basic automation using tools such as LabVIEW, Python, or equivalent platforms. Knowledge of functional, electrical, environmental, vibration, shock, thermal, ingress-protection, durability, electromagnetic compatibility, communication, and fault-insertion testing, as applicable. Familiarity with circuit calculations, component selection and derating, simulation, schematic review, printed circuit board design review, prototype bring-up, and bench debugging. Working knowledge of design failure mode and effects analysis, root-cause analysis, structured problem solving, corrective-action verification, configuration management, and engineering change control. Awareness of automotive product-development and quality practices; familiarity with Automotive SPICE, ISO 26262, electromagnetic compatibility standards, and applicable customer or industry standards is preferred. Sound analytical skills and the ability to document assumptions, data, test evidence, risks, and technical conclusions."" Clear written and verbal communication, including concise test reports, technical presentations, and timely status updates. Collaboration across electronics, systems, software, mechanical, manufacturing, quality, sourcing, laboratory, supplier, customer, and global engineering teams. Learning agility and willingness to seek guidance while building technical depth. Ownership of assigned deliverables, attention to detail, disciplined follow-through, and effective time management. Data-based problem solving, sound judgment, curiosity, and timely escalation of risks. Customer focus, integrity, inclusion, and a strong commitment to safety and quality."

title: Senior Technical Support Engineer
description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.
  
  
So, what’s the role all about?
  
  
NiCE is building SPARK, a new internal incubation team that turns great ideas from across CX International into working AI solutions, and then into enterprise-grade tools that roll out to colleagues around the world. Every tool we launch needs a great front door, and that is the Support Helpdesk.
  
  
As Support Helpdesk in the SPARK team, you will be the first point of contact for colleagues using the AI tools SPARK builds: answering questions, triaging issues, fixing what you can, and escalating what you cannot, with clear evidence. You are an advanced software engineer at heart, so you can go beyond scripts and FAQs: read logs, test an API call, spot a configuration or prompt problem, and explain it in simple terms.
  
  
You will be the primary helpdesk owner, supported by a backup or rotating colleague for cover, and you will partner closely with the AI Architects & Builders and the Change Management & Evangelist. What you learn from users will shape what SPARK builds and improves next.
  
  
How will you make an impact?
  
  
You will own the user support experience for SPARK solutions, keeping colleagues productive and feeding what you learn back into the tools.
  
  
Support Our Users
  
  

* Be the first point of contact for user questions, access requests, and issues, through the team’s support channels
* Triage, prioritise, and track every request through to resolution in the ticketing system, with clear and timely updates to users
* Troubleshoot technical issues by reviewing logs, testing API calls, checking configurations and prompts, reproducing problems, and fixing what is within your reachEscalate to the AI Architects & Builders with clear reproduction steps, evidence, and impact, so engineers can act fast

Build Knowledge
  
  

* Create and maintain FAQs, how-to guides, and a searchable knowledge base for every SPARK solution
* Document known issues, workarounds, and runbooks, and keep them current as solutions change
* Help onboard new users and groups, working with the Change Management & Evangelist on guides and training materials

Spot Patterns and Improve
  
  

* Analyse ticket trends to identify recurring issues, usability gaps, and training needs, and report them to the Change Management & Evangelist and the AI Architects & Builders
* Track support metrics such as volume, response and resolution times, user satisfaction, and top issues, and share regular summaries
* Capture user feedback and feature requests for the product backlog
* Create real time dashboard for requestor to have visibility into progress

Automate and Cover
  
  

* Use scripts and AI tools to automate repetitive support tasks such as triage, routing, FAQ answers, and reporting
* Coordinate with your backup or rotating support colleague to maintain coverage during absences and busy periods
* Help monitor usage and platform health, and raise alerts on anything that looks wrong

Have you got what it takes?
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* 4-8 years of experience as a software engineer, or in L2/L3 application or technical support for software products
* Hands-on technical skills: scripting or programming (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar), SQL, REST APIs, tools such as Postman, and reading application logs
* Experience with ticketing and service management tools such as ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, or similar
* Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills, and the patience to guide non-technical users clearly
* Excellent written communication: clear, friendly, and concise answers and documentation
* Everyday use of generative AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or Copilot, and an understanding of how AI answers can go wrong
* An ownership mindset: you stay with an issue until it is resolved or handed over cleanly
* Fluency in English
* Ability to work support hours that cover the regions the team serves (working pattern to be confirmed)

You will have an advantage if you also have:
  
  

* Experience supporting internal AI tools, chatbots, or agent platforms
* Experience building automations or lightweight bots for support
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Azure, and with basic CI/CD
* Experience with knowledge base tools and writing technical documentation
* Background in CX, contact centre, CCaaS, or enterprise SaaS support
* Experience supporting users across multiple time zones

What’s in it for you?
  
  
SPARK is a chance to be a founding member of a brand-new team, and to shape how NiCE turns AI ideas into everyday tools used by colleagues around the world.
  
  
Join an ever-growing, market-disrupting, global company where the teams, comprised of the best of the best, work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate about AI, innovative at heart, and excited to constantly raise the bar on what intelligent technology can do, you may just be our next NiCEr!
  
  
Enjoy NiCE-FLEX!
  
  
At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.
  
  
**Req ID:**
11868
  
  
**Reporting into:**
Tech Manager, Engineering, CX
  
  
**Role Type:**
Individual Contributor
  
  
**About NiCE**
*NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions.*
*Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8,500 employees across 30+ countries.*
*NiCE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, neurotype, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other category protected by law.*

title: Electronic Systems Technical Specialist - Software
description:
**Job Summary**
This applied technology position creates software that is sold as an integral part of Cummins’ products. People in these positions have involvement in identification and understanding of stakeholder requirements and developing specifications, and responsibility for design, implementation, testing and/or release of software that controls the operation of Cummins’ products in a variety of customer applications.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Investigates product software problems, understands causal mechanisms, recommends appropriate action, owns problem resolution, and documents results. Applies and improves the improvement of product software development processes and tools. Processes include coding, compiling and test. Tools include code editors, integration tools, static analysis tools, compilers and hardware in the loop test tools. Details specific to this role may be found at the end of this document. Obtains input and negotiates with product and software development teams and delivers verified software features, components, builds to product teams. Uses systems knowledge and expertise to make decisions in the areas of software requirements, architecture, design, and test that impact the quality and performance of software builds, product lines (platforms) and management of cross-BU integration and coordination. Responsible for review of less-experienced developers/testers’ work to ensure robust, reusable, and efficient designs. Responsibile for interacting and collaborating with cross-functional teams. Provides independent leadership of smaller business impact projects or ownership of complex components, products, systems or services with greater elements of ambiguity over the senior or lead engineer level and with full accountability to the project team. Delivers independent execution of established and emerging work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge. Leads the development and improvement of work processes and systems across function(s) within a global business unit or managing improvement across business units. Coordinates and directs work amongst technicians and temporary student employees, assists in the transfer of knowledge to lesser experienced engineers through either indirect (scope of influence) or direct management of a small, local group of engineers. Provides support and guidance to influence technical direction within a project team and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role. Operates as a recognized specialist in a discipline or product area within the immediate team.
  
  
**Competencies**
Product Failure Mode Avoidance - Mitigates potential product failure modes, by identifying interfaces, functions, functional requirements, interactions, control factors, noise factors, and prioritized potential failure modes and potential failure causes for the system of interest to effectively and efficiently improve the reliability of Cummins’ products.
  
  
Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis - Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub-system and/or component level requirements.
  
  
Product Platform Planning and Architecting - Creates and develops a holistic product platform including key architectural feature and function variants needed to align with market level product plans of future target markets; generates alternative architectures traceable to the requirements and performs trade-off analysis in collaboration with life-cycle stakeholders to ensure a balanced and optimum platform; communicates and maintains traceable information and plans executed by product development teams.
  
  
Product Software Design and Construction - Constructs product software using industry best practices and robust software engineering principles; verifies software updates to ensure quality products.
  
  
Product Verification and Validation Management - Develops product systems validation plans from a variety of inputs to identify failure modes, while managing product risk and relative priority; negotiates product requirements against capability to guide project scope; evaluates analytical, simulation and physical test results to verify product capability and validate requirements; assesses legacy versus proposed system solution capabilities and produces recommendations with technical documentation to support product decisions.
  
  
System Requirements Engineering - Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.
  
  
Systems Thinking - Defines the system of interest by drawing the boundaries, identifying its context within its environment, its interfaces, and that it has a lifecycle to aid in planning the problem statement, scope and deliverables ; analyzes linkages and interactions between elements that comprise the system of interest by using appropriate methods, models and integration of outcomes to understand the system, predict its behavior and devise modifications to it in order to produce the desired effects.
