title: Lead Quality (Warranty domain)
description:
Lead Quality - Warranty (Field Failure & Complaint Analysis)

**Location:**
Pune / Multiple Plant Locations

**Experience:**
10-12 Years

**Qualification:**
B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, Automotive Engineering

Role Purpose

The Customer Quality Assurance (CQA) professional will lead technical investigations of customer complaints, warranty returns, and field failures across Electrical & Electronics product lines. The role will focus on identifying scientifically validated root causes, driving corrective and preventive actions, strengthening product and process robustness, and ensuring compliance with automotive quality standards while enhancing customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Complaint & Failure Analysis

* Lead detailed investigations of customer complaints involving mechanical, electrical, electronic, software, material, and system-level failures.
* Analyze customer rejection trends, warranty claims, and defect patterns using quality tools and statistical techniques.
* Correlate field failures with manufacturing, testing, and validation data to identify root causes.
* Perform Measurement System Analysis (MSA) and Statistical Process Control (SPC) studies to validate conclusions.
* Prepare technical reports and support customer discussions for complaint closure.

Quality Standards & Compliance

* Ensure adherence to IATF 16949, ISO 9001, VDA, AIAG, and OEM-specific quality requirements.
* Support customer audits, internal audits, Layered Process Audits (LPA), and compliance reviews.
* Govern the deployment of APQP, PPAP, SPC, MSA, FMEA, Control Plans, and reliability standards.

Structured Problem Solving

* Drive root cause investigations using:
* 8D Methodology
* A3 Problem Solving
* PDCA
* 5 Why Analysis
* Fishbone Diagram
* Fault Tree Analysis (FTA)
* Cause & Effect Matrix
* Design of Experiments (DOE)
* Validate corrective actions through testing, simulation, and evidence-based analysis.

Warranty & Reliability Engineering

* Conduct field failure and warranty analysis using:
* Weibull Analysis
* Failure Rate Modeling
* Reliability Growth Analysis
* Life Prediction & Degradation Modelling
* Identify recurring failure modes and reliability risks.
* Collaborate with R&D and Quality teams to address product and process vulnerabilities.

Preventive Quality Improvement

* Integrate customer complaint learnings into:
* DFMEA & PFMEA Updates
* Design Robustness Improvements
* DVP&R Enhancement
* Special Characteristic Identification
* Control Plan Optimization
* Error Proofing (Poka-Yoke) Initiatives
* Drive continuous improvement projects to reduce customer complaints and warranty failures.

Analytics & Reporting

* Develop dashboards and metrics for:
* Customer Complaints
* Warranty Trends
* Product-wise Failure Analysis
* Root Cause Distribution
* Corrective Action Effectiveness
* Provide predictive insights and early warnings on emerging quality concerns.

Cross Functional Collaboration

* Partner with R&D, NPD, Manufacturing Engineering, Plant Quality, Supplier Quality, and Component Development teams.
* Facilitate problem-solving workshops and coach teams on advanced quality methodologies.
* Drive standardization of complaint analysis processes across multiple manufacturing locations.

title: Technical Support Representative
description:
**Description**
Shape the Future for Cybersecuirty with Us
  
  
Every day cyberattacks threaten to disrupt hospitals, power grids, financial systems, and the infrastructure we all depend on. At Forescout, we build defenses that keep civilization running smoothly in an increasingly connected world.
  
  
For more than 25 years, Fortune 100 organizations, government agencies, and large enterprises have trusted Forescout as their foundation to manage cyber risk, ensure compliance, and mitigate threats. From power grids and healthcare systems to financial networks and transportation hubs, Forescout protects the critical infrastructure of our modern world.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
The Technical Support Representative (TSR) is a key support resource and essential contributor to the Customer Success Organization. As a member of the Technical Support Engineering Team, you will have the opportunity to work closely with and learn from a team of highly skilled security engineers and technical leaders. This is an excellent opportunity for substantial professional growth and to develop your technical skills across a broad range of products.
  
  
In this role, you will assist customers with technical issues to ensure optimal performance of our products and solutions within large and complex customer environments. The TSR is the first point of contact and the first level of support for our customers. You will need a solid understanding of ForeScout products and basic knowledge of the environments in which they are deployed. Under the guidance of Technical Support Leadership, you will take ownership of assigned projects to address and resolve customer issues. Competencies essential to your success in this role include customer service, problem-solving, organization, and time management combined with agility of learning and technical aptitude.
  
  

* Process Lead/Customer portal registrations
* Troubleshooting and investigating customer-reported issues.
* Share relevant KB’s and documentation with customers.
* Assist in Customer login creation cases.
* Handle licensing, hardware, and low-severity cases within guidelines and escalate if necessary.
* Manage RMA cases once processed by TSE and monitor them until completion.
* Can be replaced with: Escalate unresolved issues to TSE’s. Provides collaborative support to customers, other ForeScout employees, and partners.
* Follow standard processes and procedures.
* Collaborate and answer questions in the Customer Portal.
* Can be replaced with: Assist TSE’s with collecting relevant information on case + logs etc.
* Creates KB articles and notes.
* Increase personal technical knowledge through online training, documentation, and hands-on experience.
* Provide feedback to improve product quality/functionality

**Technical Qualifications**
**What You Will Bring To Forescout**

* Basic level of understanding of Operating Systems (Linux, Windows, Macintosh, and UNIX).
* Good knowledge of enterprise networking environments.
* Experience installing and implementing network access control security solutions is a plus.
* Self-starter with initiative to learn the product in a training class and on-the-job.

**General Qualifications**

* 3+ years of experience in a customer-facing support role (In an Enterprise level support environment is a plus).
* 3+ years of experience troubleshooting hardware-related issues.
* Outstanding customer-facing skills.
* A team player who can also work independently in a fast and dynamic technical support environment.
* Ability to assess situations and adapt according to customer needs.
* Capable of documenting problems and solutions for internal as well external customers.
* Ability to follow documentation and case management practices.
* Flexible working in the rotational shift .

What Forescout Offers You
  
  
At Forescout, visionary leadership, continuous learning, and career development are central to our success. Our diverse and inclusive culture empowers people to collaborate, innovate, and make a meaningful impact on global security while working with industry-leading technology. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, recognize those who take initiative and contribute fully, and provide exciting opportunities to grow alongside our business. Learn more at www.Forescout.com.
  
  
Our Mission
  
  
To continuously identify, protect, and ensure the compliance of all cyber assets across the modern organisation.
  
  
Our Vision
  
  
A world where every cyber asset is seen, secure and compliant.
  
  
Our Cultural Values
  
  

* One Team – We all work together, and we all win together.
* Cyber Obsessed – We are curious about technology, and we are innovative and passionate about solving big programs.
* Customer Driven – We listen, we learn, and we make it right.
* Relentless – We're smart, determined, and find a way. We figure stuff out.
* Collaborative, without Ego – No one succeeds alone. We strive to be the humble person that people want to work with.

Thank you for taking the time to learn more about us.
  
  
If this opportunity intrigues you, we would love for you to apply!
  
  
Pre-Employment Screening and Verification
  
  
At Forescout, we are “Cyber Obsessed”. As a global cybersecurity company, we are committed to maintaining a secure environment for our customers, employees, and business operations. To support these efforts, candidates may be asked to complete job-related pre-employment screening and verification processes, to the extent permitted by applicable law. Depending on the role and location, these measures may include identity verification, employment verification, background screening, work authorization verification, and other lawful security-related checks. Forescout conducts these processes in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, including privacy and data protection requirements, and obtains any required notices, authorizations, or consents before conducting such screenings.
  
  
Notice Regarding the Use of Artificial Intelligence in Recruitment
  
  
As part of our recruitment process, we may use artificial intelligence ("AI") or automated decision-support tools to review applications, assess job-related qualifications, match candidates to role requirements, and coordinate interviews. These tools support, but do not replace, the judgment of qualified recruiters and hiring managers, who remain involved throughout the process. We use AI responsibly and in accordance with applicable laws, regulations, and internal governance standards.
  
  
Note to Employment Agencies
  
  
We value the partnerships we have built with our preferred vendors. Forescout does not accept unsolicited resumes from employment agencies.  Submissions made without a signed Employment Placement Agreement and an authorized search engagement for the specific position through our Talent Acquisition team will be considered unsolicited, and no placement fee will be paid.
  
  
Forescout Technologies is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We value and embrace diversity, equality, inclusion, and collaboration at the core of our “One Team” philosophy. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

title: Technical Manager – Traction Power Supply Systems – Rail Electrification (m/f/d)
description:
**Hello Visionary!**
We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly evolving world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make a phenomenal addition to our vibrant international team.
  
  
**We are looking for a Technical Manager – Traction Power Supply Systems – Rail Electrification (m/f/d)**
**You’ll make a difference by:**

* Delivering the end-to-end traction power supply system/subsystem within the specified time, cost, and quality requirements.
* Preparing preliminary and detailed electrical engineering drawings, including overview diagrams, single-line diagrams, layouts, BOQs, etc.
* Conducting technical reviews and submitting designs for AC and DC traction power supply substations, auxiliary power supply systems, and emergency power supply systems (UPS and DC distribution systems) for traction power supply.
* Conducting technical reviews and submitting technical specifications for electrical subsystems (HV/MV/LV equipment, including transformers, cables, etc.) within substations.
* Coordinating technical and non-technical interfaces with collaborators such as project managers, suppliers, and other subsystems (e.g., signaling, civil, etc.) to ensure the integration of all electrical systems within substations.
* Managing, planning, organizing, and controlling engineering work packages for traction substation design.
* Controlling and reporting on projects or sub-projects to stakeholders.
* Participating in contract management and project compliance processes for traction power supply systems.
* Identifying and leading opportunities and risks within the project or sub-projects.
* Providing technical support during the manufacturing, testing, installation, and commissioning phases.
* Leading technical deliverables with sales departments and project management during both the bid phase and the project realization phase.
* Coordinating with functional managers in line-organization for vital support and provisioning.
* Managing technical clarifications with domestic and international sub-suppliers.
* Visiting domestic and international suppliers and project locations to witness equipment testing and attend stakeholder meetings.
* Participating in technical liaison meetings with customers, suppliers, and Siemens’ internal departments globally.

**You’ll win us over by:**

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in electrical engineering or a similar field, ideally in power distribution, electrical control systems, or traction power substation design.
* Knowledge of high- and medium-voltage technology, with a good understanding of system design, manufacturing processes, installation, training, and testing and commissioning activities in electrical substations.
* Knowledge of auxiliary and emergency power supply systems.
* Knowledge of earthing and bonding systems for electrical substations.
* Knowledge of measurement, control, and supervisory systems.
* Knowledge of relevant European and international standards (IEC, IEEE, EN).
* Knowledge of engineering processes.
* Knowledge of engineering and technical management for electrical systems.
* Experience in project realization, preferably in an international project environment.

Desirable
  
  

* Experience in the railway sector, especially in railway electrification power supply systems.
* Experience in the design and planning of electrical AC/DC substations.
* Intercultural experience and strong English language skills.
* German language skills (reading, writing, and speaking) will be an advantage.

We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us.
  
  
This role is based in Pune, where you’ll get the chance to work with teams, impacting entire cities, countries - and the shape of things to come.
  
  
We’re Siemens. A collection of over 312,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. + Prepare and submit complex non-financial regulatory reports for various jurisdictions and products, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timeliness.
+ Act as a primary point of contact for coordination with partner units for exceptions and clarifications pertaining to identified issues.
+ Analyze regulatory reporting processes from front to back to identify gaps and improvement opportunities.

* Stakeholder & Governance Support:

+ Collaborate with Risk, Compliance, and Technology partners to support integrated reporting solutions.
+ Prepare materials and participate in governance forums to provide updates on specific reports or issues.
+ Prepare information and draft communications for routine regulatory matters as required.

+ Solid experience in transactional regulatory reporting and a deep understanding of operational processes and controls.
+ Proven experience working with business stakeholders within a cross-functional matrix environment.

title: RC FS-MS - EY COMPLY and RVS- US Regulatory Reporting BCM-Staff
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Risk Consulting – EY Comply: Position: Staff – Regulatory Reporting**
At EY, we’re all in to help shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centres. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service focuses on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery, and IT Global Infrastructure services are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
You will be responsible for executing tasks with increasing autonomy, applying sound judgment within defined parameters, and contributing to team outcomes. You are expected to demonstrate initiative, resolve routine issues independently, and support junior colleagues.
  
  
You will anticipate and identify risks within engagements and share any issues with senior members of the team.
  
  
In line with EY commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of high quality and is reviewed by the next-level reviewer.
  
  
We are looking for a skilled Regulatory Reporting Professional to support the delivery of technology-enabled regulatory reporting services for digital asset clients. The role focuses on end-to-end report production, data validation, reconciliations, controls, issue management, and regulatory change across U.S. and global reporting obligations. This position offers the opportunity to work closely with clients, onshore teams, technology teams, and operations stakeholders to strengthen reporting accuracy, improve governance, support automation, and build scalable processes aligned with evolving products, entities, and regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Regulatory Production & Submissions: Lead regulatory reporting workstreams, including end-to-end preparation, review, and timely submission of U.S. and global filings such as MTL reporting, transaction reporting, financial condition reporting, and capital calculations.
* Broader Banking Regulatory Reporting Exposure: Apply relevant exposure to banking regulatory returns, including capital adequacy, liquidity reporting, ICAAP reporting, balance sheet reporting, and regulatory disclosures, where applicable to the client’s operating model.
* Regulatory Change, Awareness & Reporting Logic: Monitor relevant regulatory developments, interpret reporting instructions, assess data and process impacts, and coordinate timely updates to reporting logic, templates, procedures, controls, and technology workflows.
* Data Sourcing & Analytical Reviews: Perform complex data extraction, validation, variance analysis, and root-cause exception investigations across large datasets to ensure data completeness and integrity.
* Control Governance & Audit Readiness: Embed rigorous quality controls—including maker-checker reviews, clear audit trails, evidence retention, and sign-off protocols—across all reporting cycles.
* Automation & Process Improvement: Identify reporting process inefficiencies and support automation initiatives using tools such as SQL, Python, and modern data platforms to reduce manual effort and operational risk.
* Analytics & Responsible AI Awareness: Apply awareness of responsible AI and analytics use cases to support anomaly detection, exception analysis, reporting commentary, and workflow monitoring.
* Team Leadership & Stakeholder Alignment: Provide technical coaching and review support to junior team members while coordinating seamlessly across cross-functional partners and U.S.-based stakeholders.
* Time-Zone Flexibility: Willingness to operate during late/extended hours to ensure seamless hand-offs with U.S.-based stakeholders and meet strict global submission deadlines.
* Al fluency - Demonstrates broad knowledge of AI trends, opportunities, and risks within operations. Supports the implementation of AI driven process improvements, encourages responsible AI adoption within the team, and contributes to efficiency and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* 2-4 years of relevant work experience in regulatory reporting or financial services.
* Hands-on experience with U.S. regulatory filings, financial condition reporting, customer liability reporting, permissible investments, transaction reporting, and Money Transmitter License (MTL) submissions.
* Master’s degree in accounting, finance, business, or a related field is preferred; CA, CPA, CFA, MBA, or an equivalent professional qualification would be an advantage.
* Strong end-to-end understanding of regulatory reporting production cycles, data validation, reconciliations, variance analysis, workpaper preparation, and review controls.
* Solid working knowledge of financial statement analysis, regulatory capital concepts, ICAAP reporting, and applicable regulatory compliance frameworks.
* Exposure to banking regulatory reporting frameworks, including capital adequacy, ICAAP reporting, liquidity risk reporting, balance sheet schedules, and regulatory disclosures, would be beneficial.
* Proven ability to translate complex regulatory mandates into business requirements.
* Knowledge of reporting platforms and data tools, along with hands-on experience in SQL, Python, Snowflake, or Looker, would be an added advantage.
* Awareness of Generative AI tools and workflow automation to support data extraction, exception analysis, and reporting efficiency would be an advantage.
* Strong control mindset, including practical experience with maker-checker reviews, robust audit trails, evidence retention, issue management, and key risk/control testing.
* Advanced data analytics skills, with the ability to query large datasets, perform root-cause analysis on exceptions, and communicate structured findings clearly.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of effectively managing relationships across onshore/offshore teams, product managers, engineers, and executive stakeholders.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, demonstrating strong ownership, continuous improvement, and agility in adapting to evolving regulatory landscapes.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint is required. U.S. visa readiness or international travel willingness is preferred but not mandatory.

**<< What we look for>>**
We are looking for a professional with strong Reporting knowledge, and excellent analytical & communication skills. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, demonstrates ownership and consistently delivers high quality work while meeting deadlines.
  
  
**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment**
: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, and a sense of belonging is fostered. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply**

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion.”

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

* Partner with project statisticians and programming teams to develop global tools that support project programming needs and the effective implementation of CDISC standards.

* Contribute to other IQVIA initiatives as a CDISC standards representative.

title: Implementation Engineer III
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.
  
  
**Job Summary**
OpenGov’s Professional Services (PS) team delivers configurable, scalable solutions to state and local governments using Government App Builder (GAB) — OpenGov’s proprietary low-code/no-code application development platform.
  
  
As a Business Application Developer III, you will design, configure, and enhance customer or business specific applications using platform capabilities, configuration, data modeling, workflow automation, and limited scripting.
  
  
**You Will Split Your Time Between**

* Designing and configuring business applications using Government App Builder
* Partnering directly with implementation teams and customers to translate business processes into scalable, automated solutions

This role is ideal for a technically strong problem solver who understands data modeling, workflow logic, and business process design — but does not require heavy full-stack engineering in frameworks such as React, NodeJS, or Java. You will play a key role in delivering high-impact solutions that modernize government operations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Application Configuration & Solution Design
* Partner with customers and implementation teams to understand operational workflows and system requirements.
* Translate business requirements into scalable application designs within Government App Builder.
* Configure entities, forms, fields, validations, permissions, dashboards, and reports.
* Apply structured configuration standards to ensure usability, maintainability, and scalability.
* Participate in validation sessions and backlog refinement to align configuration with scope.
* Data Modeling & Architecture
* Design structured data models including entity relationships and cross-table references.
* Apply data modeling best practices including normalization, denormalization trade-offs, and referential integrity.
* Configure field-level validations and data constraints to ensure data quality.
* Support data migrations including field mapping, data transformation, and validation of imported records.
* Troubleshoot data inconsistencies and recommend corrective design patterns.
* Workflow & Process Automation
* Configure approval workflows, routing logic, conditional triggers, and status transitions.
* Implement task assignments, notification rules, and automation components.
* Translate documented decision trees and business rules into platform logic.
* Optimize workflows for compliance, accountability, and audit transparency.
* Ensure scalability of workflows across departments and user roles.
* Business Rule Implementation & Light Scripting
* Implement conditional logic using platform configuration tools.
* Write limited JavaScript (or similar scripting) for:
* Complex validations
* Calculations and derived fields
* Conditional routing
* Data transformation logic
* Maintain clean, reusable logic patterns without overengineering or heavy custom code.
* Integrations & Interoperability
* Configure and validate integrations between Government App Builder and external systems (e.g., ERP, financial systems).
* Support API-based, file-based, event-based or scheduled data exchange patterns.
* Design field mappings and transformation logic to ensure data consistency across systems.
* Document integration patterns and reusable configuration standards.
* Embedded Delivery Support
* Serve as a technical configuration specialist within active customer implementations.
* Partner with Project Managers and Implementation Consultants to deliver configured solutions on time and within scope.
* Troubleshoot configuration issues during UAT and go-live phases.
* Provide technical documentation and knowledge transfer to Customer Success teams.
* Project & Delivery Management
* Contribute technical effort estimates for configuration and automation tasks.
* Manage work across multiple concurrent engagements.
* Ensure timely delivery of configured applications within broader project timelines.
* Maintain high standards of quality, documentation, and responsiveness.

**Required Qualifications**

* Total 3 to 9 years of work experience, including 3+ years of experience in low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Appian, Microsoft Power Apps, Mendix, ServiceNow, etc.) or enterprise application configuration roles.
* Strong understanding of data modeling concepts like entity relationships, referential integrity, normalization, and denormalization.
* Experience designing and implementing business workflows and approval automation.
* Working knowledge of JavaScript or similar scripting language for implementing business rules.
* Ability to translate complex business processes into structured, configurable application logic.
* Experience with integrations (REST APIs, file-based transfers, event based workflows or batch processes).
* Experience integrating third-party APIs and embedding outputs into larger application workflows.
* Strong understanding of security standards (e.g., OAuth 2.0, JWT), and API documentation tools (e.g., Swagger/OpenAPI).
* Strong analytical thinking with systems and process-improvement mindset.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Proven success working in fast-paced, iterative environments with cross-functional stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in GovTech or public-sector workflows (budgeting, grants management, procurement, capital planning, permitting, capital project management etc.).
* Background in Professional Services, consulting, or customer-facing implementation roles.
* Familiarity with security concepts such as role-based access control and data governance practices.

**Why Join OpenGov Professional Services**
You Will Help Modernize Government Operations By Designing Configurable, Scalable Applications That Replace Spreadsheets, Manual Workflows, And Disconnected Systems. As Part Of Our Professional Services Team, You Will
  
  

* Build impactful solutions without heavy custom engineering overhead.
* Shape best practices for Government App Builder implementations.
* Collaborate with the platform engineering team for improving and enhancing the platform for required capabilities.
* Work with mission-driven teams serving state and local governments.
* Develop expertise in workflow automation, structured data modeling, and enterprise configuration at scale.

**Why OpenGov?**
**A Mission That Matters.**
At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.
  
  
**Opportunity to Innovate**
The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.
  
  
**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**
This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.
  
  
**A Place to Make Your Mark**
We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.
  
  
**Benefits That Work For You**
Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:
  
  

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

title: EV Trainer (Electric Vehicle)
description:
**Role:**
EV Trainer
**Experience:**
1–2 Years
**Qualification:**
Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Electrical, Electronics, Automobile, Mechatronics or a related discipline
**Engagement:**
Project-based / Contractual / Part-time, depending on project requirements
**Role Purpose**
To deliver practical and classroom-based Electric Vehicle (EV) training to ITI students and support the development of technical skills among students and faculty. The trainer will focus on EV fundamentals, hands-on demonstrations, basic troubleshooting, and industry-relevant technical knowledge.
**Key Responsibilities**

* Deliver classroom and practical training on Electric Vehicle (EV) technology to ITI students.
* Explain EV fundamentals, vehicle architecture, battery systems, motors, controllers, and charging systems.
* Conduct hands-on demonstrations and practical sessions using EV lab equipment.
* Provide basic training on Battery Management Systems (BMS), power electronics, and automotive electrical systems.
* Demonstrate basic EV maintenance, fault identification, troubleshooting, and safety procedures.
* Assist in developing training presentations, practical exercises, assignments, and assessment materials.
* Support Train-the-Trainer (ToT) programs for ITI instructors and faculty, as required.
* Assist ITI colleges in utilizing EV lab equipment and conducting practical sessions effectively.
* Evaluate student learning outcomes through practical assessments, tests, and demonstrations.
* Maintain training attendance, assessment records, and other project-related documentation.
* Keep training content updated with relevant EV technologies and industry practices.
* Travel to ITI colleges and training centres as required by project needs.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Basic knowledge of Electric Vehicle Technology and EV architecture.
* Understanding of EV batteries and Battery Management Systems (BMS).
* Familiarity with electric motors, motor controllers, and power electronics.
* Basic knowledge of EV charging systems and charging infrastructure.
* Understanding of automotive electrical and electronic systems.
* Ability to perform basic diagnostics, maintenance, and troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of EV safety practices, including electrical safety and safe handling of batteries.
* Good communication, presentation, and classroom management skills.
* Willingness to learn new technologies and deliver hands-on technical training.

**Experience & Qualification**

* Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Electrical, Electronics, Automobile, Mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline.
* 1–2 years of relevant experience in EV technology, automotive electrical systems, electrical maintenance, technical training, or a related field.
* Fresh graduates with strong practical EV knowledge and relevant hands-on project experience may also be considered.
* Experience in ITI, Polytechnic, vocational training, or skill development programmes will be an advantage.
* Prior exposure to EV labs, battery systems, charging equipment, or automotive workshops is preferred.
* Good verbal communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts in simple language.

description:
**About Us**
We are a global climate technologies company engineered for sustainability. We create sustainable and efficient residential, commercial and industrial spaces through HVACR technologies. We protect temperature-sensitive goods throughout the cold chain. And we bring comfort to people globally. Best-in-class engineering, design and manufacturing combined with category-leading brands in compression, controls, software and monitoring solutions result in next-generation climate technology that is built for the needs of the world ahead.

Join our team and start your journey today!
  
  
We are looking for an Oracle IT Analyst with hands-on functional experience beyond end-user activities, who is motivated to build and grow a long-term career working with Oracle E-Business Suite.

**Pune- Maharashtra - India.**

**hybrid**
.

* Map existing (“as-is”) business processes, perform gap analysis, and design optimized (“to-be”) processes aligned with Oracle EBS capabilities.
* Create and maintain functional documentation, including scope documents, functional design documents, use cases, process flows, and user training materials.
* Develop and execute functional test scripts and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to ensure solutions meet business requirements.
* Provide end-user training and ongoing functional and technical support, including issue resolution and management of Oracle Service Requests (SRs).
* Act as a key liaison between business users and technical teams, ensuring effective communication and successful delivery of IT solutions.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying process efficiencies and system enhancement opportunities.

**For This Role You Will Need**

* University degree in Information Technology, Business, Supply Chain, or a related field.
* 5–7 years of hands-on experience with Oracle E-Business Suite R12, with strong functional expertise in Distribution (Procurement/Order Management) modules.
* Solid understanding of the Procure-to-Pay (P2P)/ Order to Cash(O2C) lifecycle and related supply chain business processes.
* Experience with at least one end-to-end Oracle implementation or multiple Oracle Procurement support projects.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work independently.
* Experience creating functional documentation and process maps.
* Working knowledge of SQL for querying tables and reading packages.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

**Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart**

* Functional knowledge of ASCP AND Manufacturing modules.
* Experience working in a global or cross-functional environment.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to communicate effectively at all organizational levels.
* Proactive, pragmatic, and results-oriented mindset.

Across the globe, we are united by a singular Purpose: Sustainability is no small ambition. That’s why everything we do is geared toward a sustainable future—for our generation and all those to come. Through groundbreaking innovations, HVACR technology and cold chain solutions, we are reducing carbon emissions and improving energy efficiency in spaces of all sizes, from residential to commercial to industrial.
  
  
Our employees are our greatest strength. We believe that our culture of passion, openness, and collaboration empowers us to work toward the same goal - to make the world a better place. We invest in the end-to-end development of our people, beginning at onboarding and through senior leadership, so they can thrive personally and professionally.
  
  
Flexible and competitive benefits plans offer the right options to meet your individual/family needs. We provide employees with flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation and holiday leave.
  
  
Together, we have the opportunity – and the power – to continue to revolutionize the technology behind air conditioning, heating and refrigeration, and cultivate a better future. Learn more about us and how you can join our team!

* Use available resources, including AI\-based support platforms, responsibly and effectively to complement engineering analysis and improve support quality.
* Continuously develop technical expertise in one or more structural simulation areas.
* Build an understanding of Japanese customers’ engineering workflows, business expectations, and communication requirements.
* Contribute to high customer satisfaction through responsiveness, professionalism, teamwork, and a strong sense of ownership.
* Participate in other team and company initiatives as needed.
* Remain flexible and open to new responsibilities based on business and customer needs.


 What You'll Need
   

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Applied Mechanics, Aerospace Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Civil Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* Sound academic or practical knowledge of structural mechanics and finite element analysis.
* Basic understanding of numerical simulation methods and the ability to interpret engineering results.
* Demonstrated logical problem\-solving skills and the ability to investigate technical issues systematically.
* Ability to communicate fluently and effectively in English, both verbally and in writing.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate technical information clearly to customers and colleagues.
* Ability to work collaboratively with colleagues in India, Japan, and other global locations.
* Ability to work independently on assigned tasks while seeking guidance or escalating issues when appropriate.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Customer\-focused mindset, professional conduct, and willingness to take ownership of assigned responsibilities.
* Engineering curiosity and a strong commitment to continuous learning.
* Ability to work effectively across different cultures, locations, and time zones.
* Willingness to work hours that provide reasonable coverage and collaboration with the Japan support team, subject to applicable company policies and local employment requirements.


 Who You Are
   

  

* 0\-2 Years of experience using structural simulation, finite element analysis, or related engineering software. Relevant university research, academic projects, internships, or industrial experience may be considered.
* Experience using commercial or internally developed FEA software for engineering applications.
* Familiarity with structural analysis workflows, including linear or nonlinear analysis.
* Experience in a technical support, customer\-facing, consulting, application engineering, or engineering services environment.
* Japanese\-language proficiency.
* Experience communicating or collaborating with customers or colleagues in Japan.
* Basic knowledge of Python, scripting, automation, SQL, databases, machine learning, or generative AI.
* Experience participating in an engineering product development or software testing cycle.
* Willingness to travel occasionally, if required.

 You will be part of the Synopsys Customer Excellence team, a global group of engineers focused on making customers successful with Synopsys simulation software. The team works across time zones and technical domains, supporting customers through their toughest engineering challenges and helping drive adoption of Synopsys Structural Products. You will collaborate closely with colleagues who share your commitment to solving hard problems and delivering high\-quality support.
   

  

 Rewards and Benefits
   

  

 We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

title: AO/RFP Writer - Fixed Income
description:
**Job Description**
*AllianceBernstein’s Client Group has a presence in the Americas, Europe, Asia and Australia, and is composed of five main areas:*
* Sales \& Client Services works with financial intermediaries and institutions to offer diversified investment solutions that help clients build and preserve their wealth
* Business Development is a conduit to the firm’s investment teams and supports our clients and internal business partners through investment\-platform and product content, messaging, competitive analysis and education
* Product Strategy \& Development designs, develops and manages the firm’s global lineup of investment services and considers clients’ evolving needs to identify new opportunities
* Marketing promotes the firm and its services by creating, packaging and distributing content and messaging to engage diverse audiences through digital platforms and initiatives, strategic campaigns, and events
* Business Transformation looks to evolve and scale our business, leveraging digital and data, to drive top\-line growth and improve profitability


**What You’ll Do**
*AllianceBernstein’s Request for Proposal (RFP) team is in search of a RFP writer to contribute to business development and client service through the completion of RFPs, RFIs, as well as some due diligence requests for AllianceBernstein’s Fixed Income Strategies. The Writer will specialize in writing RFPs for our Fixed Income Strategies in a timely and accurate manner, while also contributing, where needed, to the completion of other projects and requests. The Writer will be expected to be able to work effectively with the firm’s Senior RFP Writers and Management Team, Product Managers and Portfolio Managers, as well as our Sales Teams, to write and maintain (keep updated) original and technical product\-specific content to support our Fixed Income platform, and, importantly, to be able to effectively customize that content for specific sales situations as needed.*
*This position will provide an opportunity to develop knowledge in the entire new business development process: from the initial screening of an RFP, to the organization and project management of an RFP, to the actual content creation and updating of RFP language and then, finally, to the follow\-up and tracking of our RFPs. The candidate will be expected to handle a high volume of requests simultaneously and productively. Projects will be primarily related to new business opportunities, as well as some client servicing\-related including Onboarding Questionnaires and client Due Diligence Questionnaires.*
**Specific Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To**
* Write a high volume of RFPs for Fixed Income strategies and support other asset classes as needed.
* Liaise with various departments throughout the firm to collect information needed to respond to requests, including but not limited to portfolio management, product management/marketing, legal, operations, AUM reporting and performance.
* Create and maintain RFP language and content for assigned strategies of coverage, including investment process, research process, team information, and competitive advantages.
* Maintain consistent product messaging and updated product language in our RFP database.
* Collaborate directly with Product Managers, Portfolio Managers, Research Analysts, Traders, and others to update existing RFP language and develop new language.
* Customize final documents to reflect a nuanced and targeted response to the specific sales opportunity.
* Handle follow\-up work associated with RFPs moving to the next phase: coordinating answers, additional information, etc.
* Oversee production of final proposals (formatting, technical editing and reproduction).
* Coordinate multiple projects simultaneously to meet strict deadlines.
* Field ad\-hoc questions from our Client Response Center Team daily, as needed.


**What We’re Looking For**
*The ideal candidate should have:*
* Knowledge of the broader fixed income market and the asset management industry.
* Detail\-oriented with excellent project management and organizational skills; able to prioritize work and handle multiple tasks to ensure that complex projects are completed by deadline, with interim review steps incorporated.
* Strong verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills as well as the ability to work independently and as part of a team in a large global organization.
* Demonstrated desire and ability to learn technical info, including philosophy, research and investment processes of our products.
* Demonstrated initiative and good judgment as well as the ability to work well under pressure and with time constraints.
* Interest in and ability to interact directly and effectively with Sales Advisors, Portfolio Managers and other investment professionals.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, especially Word, and possess the ability to quickly master internal systems and applications.
* Experience: 5\-8 years of RFP and industry experience required. Direct experience with Fixed Income RFP content is required.
* Education: CFA Level I cleared \& MBA Finance


**About AB**
*We are a leading global investment management firm offering high\-quality research and diversified investment services to institutional clients, retail investors, and private\-wealth clients in major markets around the globe. With over 4,000 employees across 57 locations operating in 26 countries and jurisdictions, our ambition is simple: to be the most trusted investment firm in the world. We realize that it's our people who give us a competitive advantage and drive success in the market, and our goal is to create an inclusive culture that rewards hard work.*
*Our culture of intellectual curiosity and collaboration creates an environment where you can thrive and do your best work. Whether you're producing thought\-provoking research, identifying compelling investment opportunities, infusing new technologies into our business or providing thoughtful advice to our clients, we are fully invested in you. If you're ready to challenge your limits and empower your career, join us!*

*Pune, India*

description:

**Title And Summary**
 Senior Specialist, Payroll Implementation \& Integration\-1
   

  

 Position Summary
   

  

 The Senior Specialist, Payroll Implementation \& Integration supports strategic payroll initiatives, including mergers and acquisitions (M\&A), P\&C Modernization programs, system implementations, and process improvement efforts. This role serves as a key execution resource responsible for coordinating testing activities, validating payroll and employee data, supporting implementation readiness, and assisting with solution deployments across payroll operations.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 M\&A Integration Support
   

  

* Support payroll workstreams during mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, and organizational restructures.
* Assist with payroll integration planning and execution activities.
* Coordinate employee data collection, validation, and migration activities.
* Prepare implementation documentation and integration trackers.
* Support payroll readiness assessments and integration milestones.
* Monitor project tasks, risks, issues, and action items.
* Assist in stabilization activities following acquisitions.


 P\&C Modernization Implementation Support
   

  

* Participate in payroll\-related activities supporting Workday and P\&C Modernization initiatives.
* Support configuration validation and business process testing.
* Work with cross\-functional teams to evaluate payroll impacts of system changes.
* Coordinate payroll requirements gathering and documentation.
* Support process redesign and standardization initiatives.


 Testing \& Quality Assurance
   

  

* Execute end\-to\-end payroll testing activities for system implementations and enhancements.
* Develop and assist with unit testing, system integration testing (SIT), user acceptance testing (UAT), parallel payroll testing, regression testing
* Validate payroll calculations and outputs.
* Reconcile testing results and identify variances.
* Document, track, and help resolve defects.
* Verify successful implementation of payroll requirements.


 Process Improvement \& Documentation
   

  

* Create and maintain standard test scripts, process documentation, standard operating procedures

* Contribute to payroll implementation playbooks and best practices.
* Support operational readiness reviews.

* Assist with issue resolution following implementations.
* Monitor payroll processing and implementation outcomes.
* Validate corrective actions and system fixes.
* Transition completed solutions to operational payroll teams.


**Qualifications**
* 3–5 years of payroll, payroll implementation, or payroll operations experience.
* Experience supporting payroll system implementations or upgrades.
* Understanding of payroll processes, controls, and compliance requirements.
* Experience with testing methodologies and issue management.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Advanced Excel and data analysis capabilities.
* Experience supporting M\&A integrations.
* Experience with Workday, ADP, or other payroll platforms.
* Experience participating in large\-scale HR or payroll transformation programs.
* Knowledge of payroll compliance, tax, benefits, and time management processes.

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Content & Communications Specialist
description:
**About The Role**
 We are looking for a Content \& Communications Specialist to create clear, compelling, and technically accurate content across Agivant’s internal and external communication channels.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on individual\-contributor role that brings together technical writing, content and communications, and business\-oriented storytelling. You will work closely with the Marketing Lead, engineers, architects, subject\-matter experts, sales teams, business leaders, and designers to translate technical and business inputs into structured, engaging, and publish\-ready content.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will have strong writing and editorial skills, prior experience in the IT services industry, and the ability to communicate technology concepts, business value, and organizational messages effectively to different audiences.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Writing**
* Write and edit technical blogs, solution briefs, case studies, points of view, whitepapers, presentations, and service\-related content.
* Work with engineers, architects, delivery teams, and subject\-matter experts to understand technical concepts and convert their inputs into clear and accurate content.
* Simplify technology topics across AI, cloud, data, SaaS, and digital engineering for both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Ensure technical terminology, solution descriptions, capabilities, and claims are accurate and validated before publication.


**Content \& Communications**
* Create and edit website copy, LinkedIn content, newsletters, campaign content, partnership announcements, and company updates.
* Draft internal communication, including leadership messages, employee announcements, employer\-branding content, and event communication.
* Maintain Agivant’s established brand voice, messaging, tone, and editorial standards across internal and external channels.
* Own and execute the content calendar by tracking deliverables, coordinating inputs, managing reviews and approvals, and ensuring timely publishing.


**Business\-Oriented Storytelling**
* Develop case studies and client success stories that clearly articulate the business challenge, technology solution, implementation approach, and measurable outcomes.
* Translate technical capabilities into clear business value across efficiency, growth, cost reduction, customer experience, risk, and operational improvement.
* Support the creation of sales collateral, company credentials, solution narratives, presentations, and other client\-facing communication.
* Work with marketing, sales, leadership, and business teams to align content with organizational priorities, client needs, service offerings, and market opportunities.


**Content Operations**
* Coordinate with marketing, design, leadership, and business teams to ensure content is accurate, on\-brand, and delivered on schedule.
* Maintain content repositories, templates, style guides, messaging documents, and approved brand assets.
* Use content performance insights and stakeholder feedback to improve clarity, relevance, reach, and engagement.
* Use AI\-assisted writing and editing tools to improve productivity without compromising accuracy, originality, or editorial quality.


**Requirements**
**Required Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of experience in content, communications, technical writing, editorial, or related roles.
* Prior experience working in an IT services organization is mandatory.
* Strong writing, editing, proofreading, storytelling, and content\-structuring skills.
* Experience creating both technical and business\-oriented content across long\-form and short\-form formats.
* Experience developing technical blogs, case studies, solution briefs, website copy, presentations, social media content, and internal communication.
* Ability to understand technology concepts and translate technical inputs into clear, accurate, and audience\-friendly communication.
* Working knowledge of enterprise technology areas such as AI, cloud, data, SaaS, and digital engineering.
* Strong understanding of how technology capabilities connect with client challenges, business outcomes, and enterprise value.
* Experience interviewing and collaborating with engineers, architects, subject\-matter experts, business teams, and senior stakeholders.
* Proven experience managing and executing a content calendar across multiple channels, stakeholders, and deadlines.
* Strong coordination, stakeholder\-management, and follow\-up skills.
* Ability to manage multiple assignments and deliver high\-quality content within agreed timelines.
* A portfolio of published or professionally produced technical, business, and communications content.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, Mass Communication, English, Engineering, Technology, Business, or a related field.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience writing for B2B enterprise technology audiences and global clients.
* Experience creating thought\-leadership, sales\-enablement, internal communication, or employer\-branding content.
* Familiarity with SEO fundamentals, content\-management systems, and social media analytics.
* Experience using AI\-assisted tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Grammarly, or similar platforms.

title: Science Communicator on contract (Physics, Chemistry and Medicine)
description:
Editage \- Digital Media Solutions (DMS) works with scientists, universities, organizations, societies, and publishers across more than 150 accounts from around the world to visualize and disseminate their work. Through our content writing and design services, we convert complex scientific ideas into engaging content and visuals tailored to different audiences.
 



  





 We are seeking writers to develop high\-quality academic multimedia content. The role involves distilling technical source material into engaging narratives and creating storyboards for outputs such as graphical abstracts, infographics, and videos.
 



  





**Job Responsibilities** 




  




* Apply critical thinking and analytical skills to interpret published manuscripts and extract key insights, while ensuring that all content is scientifically accurate.
* Conceptualizing scientific concepts and heavy data into visual representations.
* Develop detailed storyboards with content, graphic guidance, and graphic references for designers.
* Creating scripts for video narrations.
* Creating articles, summaries, social media posts, and other content, which may include desk research to supplement content, sourcing peer\-reviewed scientific articles and citing references correctly.

* Master's and above in Physics, Chemistry or Medicine.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze manuscripts and synthesize complex information.
* Strong command of academic writing, grammar, and communication.
* Proficiency in conducting desk research and referencing scientific literature.
* Excellent responsiveness, reliability, and communication skills.



  





**Essential Skills** 



* Strong critical thinking and problem\-solving abilities.
* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.
* Creative mindset for visual storytelling in academic contexts.
* Professionalism in team interactions and feedback incorporation (as and when needed).

* Strong research and competitor, and pricing analysis skills.
* Expert knowledge of Microsoft Suite.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills

* Ability to receive, interpret, and implement constructive feedback from project stakeholders.
* Excellent communication skills – verbal and written.

 We are looking for a Product Analyst with a background in technology, or a related field. In this role, you will communicate with team members and business partners on a regular basis. You will also be responsible for testing, implementing, and maintaining software applications to improve business processes.

description:
Organization Overview:
   

  

 We are a dynamic, global, and diverse Organization, with a presence in over 60 Countries; covering all front post execution Operations teams including product aligned Middle Office groups, Settlements, Margin, Asset Servicing, Listed Derivative \& Commodities Operations. We support an extensive range of Capital Markets products and services including Fixed Income (FX, Rates, Credit, Muni, Cash and Derivatives) where Citi is consistently a dominant top 3 player in the market, Equity (Cash, Derivatives, Prime Brokerage, Futures, Listed Derivatives, FXPB) where Citi has a significant growth program to continue to build out its capabilities and services; and Syndicates where we support both FI and EQ new issues and IPOs.
   

  

 We take pride and are passionate about our People and our culture. We are invested in our People and their development. We are transforming and simplifying our operating model, creating an exciting environment which encourages diversity of thought and inclusion.
   

  

 Our Operations groups are core to the success of the Markets business and have significant impact across the lifecycle of a trade. We partner extensively with a range of internal stakeholders including Front Office Sales and Trading Desks, Compliance, Legal, Finance and HR; alongside having significant interaction with our external client base, playing a key role in the overall client experience. We have a Client relationship group, dedicated to overseeing the Organizational service performance and strategic partnership for our top tier client base, where we play a key role in supporting our global clients to ensure they have a first\-class experience when doing business with Citi.
   

  

 Our Business Intelligence and Process Re\-engineering group works alongside our Operations teams delivering automation solutions to solve for operational challenges. We partner with Citi’s innovation labs to drive optimization, and overall play a pivotal role in enabling us to transform to achieve our target operating model.
   

  

 Our Technology partners develop and implement a wide range of applications that support the Operations, Change, Design and Implementation groups in providing innovative products and solutions. We have re\-imagined how to provide technology and service in our domain through the alignment of our team vision, culture, and aggressive retirement plan for legacy applications and adoption of a micro\-based containerized cloud environment. We encourage our people to create, explore and be adventurous whilst taking measured risk, adopting safe practices to protect the firm. Data lineage and optimization is core to how we develop our eco system. We are growing our capabilities using artificial intelligence, natural language processing and machine learning.
   

  

 Our roles entail ensuring we operate in a robust control environment, whilst in a fast\-paced workplace. We comply with global regulations and internal policies and adopt a proactive approach to identifying opportunities to reduce risk through the continuous evaluation of our controls; to protect our clients, the firm, and our reputation.
   

  

 We work closely with our external global peers, partners, and regulators, and play an integral part in leading an agenda at the forefront to optimize and streamline processes and drive strategy across our industry.
   

  

 Job Purpose:
   

  

 The Markets Process Engineering team has been formed to support stakeholders both within Operations and across the bank, to design and deliver a multi\-year transformation roadmap. Our transformation is underpinned by strategy, investment change execution and a market leading change delivery team focusing on program and project management, business analysis, process re\-engineering and low code application development.
   

  

 The Futures and OTC Clearing franchise is an agency business providing trading and clearing capabilities across 40\+ exchanges to our clients and proprietary lines of business such as Equities, Rates, Commodities, FX and Prime D1\. The business is embarking on a strategic re\-engineering of its platforms. This is a multi\-year initiative, moving to real\-time computation, and with ambitious goals to design and deliver a more robust, strategic, well controlled end state for Futures and OTC Clearing Operations.
   

  

 We are recruiting for a Project/Business Analyst to help lead the delivery of strategic initiatives. This is a great opportunity to join a growing, global, and dynamic change management team, delivering a major Tier 1 program.
   

  

 The role will work in partnership with the Futures and OTC clearing business, global operations teams, technology and downstream areas such as finance and regulatory reporting.
   

  

 The core responsibilities of the Project Manager and Business Analyst include but not limited to the following:
   

  

* Develop and manage project plans, define project scope, goals, deliverables, timelines, and resource requirements to ensure successful project execution.
* Manage project lifecycle from initiation to closure, ensuring that project deliverables are met and proper evidence provided.
* Proactively identify, assess, and manage project risks, issues, and dependencies, developing and implementing effective mitigation and contingency plans.
* Create and maintain project documentation, including project charters, requirements, RAID logs, and status reports.
* Facilitate and lead project meetings, including kick\-offs, status updates, working groups and governance forums, to ensure clear and consistent communication among all project participants.
* Conduct business and data analysis to document business and operational processes and recommend improvements.
* Develop and maintain detailed process maps, use cases to support business and functional requirements
* Analyze existing business processes to identify opportunities for improvement, and assist in designing enhanced workflows
* Coordinate and support user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure that developed solutions meet business requirements and are fit for purpose.
* Prepare senior level presentations to communicate project updates
* Collaborate with stakeholders across Business, Operations, Technology, Compliance and other functions to ensure successful project implementation.


**Qualifications:**
* Project Management and Business Analysis experience
* Exchange Traded Derivatives (ETD) Regulatory Reporting knowledge is a plus
* 2\-3 years operations experience (preferably in banking)
* Critical thinking and problem solving
* Strong ability in use of Microsoft Applications (PowerPoint, Visio, Project, Word, Excel, Access)
* Proficient with the project life cycle (Waterfall \& Agile)
* CAPM, PMP, PgMP and/or MBA are a plus
* Developed communication and diplomacy skills required to persuade and influence others; may negotiate with external parties.


**Role Overview:**
 The role we are recruiting for is a hybrid Business Analyst / Project Manager role aligned to the Equities business. You will be part of the Futures \& Derivatives Clearing (FDC) and Equities Operations Program Execution Team, a key component of the Markets Ops Transformation organization. The team drives strategic transformation and delivers Target Operating Models for FDC and Equities Operations in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment
   

  

**What you'll do:**
* Project Leadership \& Delivery: Manage end\-to\-end projects from defining scope, milestones and deliverables with stakeholders to ensuring successful, on\-time delivery meeting business needs.
* Planning \& Documentation: Develop comprehensive project documentation, including charters, business requirements, plans, and risk/issue logs.
* Monitoring \& Reporting: Monitor project progress, resources, and risks, identifying and escalating issues promptly and providing timely, clear updates and presentations to all stakeholders, including senior management.
* Process Optimization: Lead business analysis efforts, clarify requirements, and drive the development and implementation of innovative, efficient processes for Equities Operations.
* Risk \& Compliance: Apply robust risk management practices and ensure regulatory compliance to protect the firm's reputation.
* Team \& Collaboration: Drive resource planning and foster strong cross\-functional collaboration across Business, Operations, Technology, Compliance, and other departments.
